circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC, 0.6 V - 1.4 V reference span, 50 MS/s.
* Sky130 1.8 V core MOS plus ideal R/C only.
*
* Architecture:
*   - 8-segment ideal resistor ladder generates the seven trip points
*     0.7 .. 1.3 V (100 mV LSB) with local decoupling capacitors that
*     absorb comparator kickback.
*   - Seven StrongARM (sense-amplifier) latches sample vin against the
*     ladder taps on the rising clock edge.
*   - Per comparator, buffer inverters isolate the sense-amplifier
*     outputs from a NOR cross-coupled SR latch, which holds the
*     decision while the sense amplifier is reset during clock low.
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder drives b2/b1/b0.

**************************************************************
* logic primitives
**************************************************************

.subckt inv2 vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv2

.subckt inv4 vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends inv4

* skewed, low-input-capacitance inverter used to isolate the sense
* amplifier from the state-dependent load of the hold latch
.subckt invs vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends invs

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y  a nm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XP2 nm b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=1
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XN1 y  a nm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN2 nm b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.6 nf=1
XN1 y  a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN2 m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN3 m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN4 m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends nand4

**************************************************************
* NOR cross-coupled SR hold latch (active-high set/reset)
*   s high -> q = 1 ; r high -> q = 0 ; both low -> hold
**************************************************************

.subckt srlatch vss vdd s r q qb
XA vss vdd r qb q  nor2
XB vss vdd s q  qb nor2
.ends srlatch

**************************************************************
* StrongARM sense-amplifier latch comparator
*   clk low  : op = on = vdd (reset)
*   clk high : op falls when vp > vn, on falls when vn > vp
* XNLK is a weak always-on tail bleeder. It keeps the tail node
* from floating up to vcm-vth during reset, so the input pair is
* already conducting when the tail switch turns on. That shortens
* the integration phase and pulls the effective sampling instant
* (aperture delay) in to <250 ps, which is what keeps the
* near-Nyquist record sampling the same codes an ideal quantizer
* would at the clock edge.
**************************************************************

.subckt sacomp vss vdd clk vp vn op on
XPR1 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPR2 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPD1 dp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPD2 dn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPL1 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XPL2 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XNL1 op on dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XNL2 on op dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XNI1 dp vp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=8
XNI2 dn vn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=8
XNT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=24.0 nf=12
XNLK tail vdd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4.0 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends sacomp

**************************************************************
* one comparator slice: sense amplifier + isolation + hold latch
* Both isolation inverters sit in the identical state while the
* sense amplifier is reset, so the load presented to sp/sn carries
* no memory of the previous decision (no regenerative hysteresis).
**************************************************************

.subckt slice vss vdd clk vp vn t tb
XC  vss vdd clk vp vn sp sn sacomp
XIS vss vdd sp s invs
XIR vss vdd sn r invs
XL  vss vdd s r t tb srlatch
.ends slice

**************************************************************
* top level
**************************************************************

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* --- reference ladder: taps at 0.7 .. 1.3 V ---
RL8 vrefp t7 1k
RL7 t7 t6 1k
RL6 t6 t5 1k
RL5 t5 t4 1k
RL4 t4 t3 1k
RL3 t3 t2 1k
RL2 t2 t1 1k
RL1 t1 vrefn 1k

CT7 t7 vss 1p
CT6 t6 vss 1p
CT5 t5 vss 1p
CT4 t4 vss 1p
CT3 t3 vss 1p
CT2 t2 vss 1p
CT1 t1 vss 1p

* --- comparator bank (tk = 1 when vin > tap k) ---
XS1 vss vdd clk vin t1 th1 th1b slice
XS2 vss vdd clk vin t2 th2 th2b slice
XS3 vss vdd clk vin t3 th3 th3b slice
XS4 vss vdd clk vin t4 th4 th4b slice
XS5 vss vdd clk vin t5 th5 th5b slice
XS6 vss vdd clk vin t6 th6 th6b slice
XS7 vss vdd clk vin t7 th7 th7b slice

* --- thermometer to binary ---
* b2 = th4
XB2A vss vdd th4  n2a inv2
XB2B vss vdd n2a  b2  inv4

* b1 = th6 + th2*th4b
XU1  vss vdd th2 th4b u1  nand2
XB1A vss vdd th6b u1  n1a nand2
XB1B vss vdd n1a n1b inv2
XB1C vss vdd n1b b1  inv4

* b0 = th7 + th1*th2b + th3*th4b + th5*th6b
XM1  vss vdd th1 th2b m1 nand2
XM3  vss vdd th3 th4b m3 nand2
XM5  vss vdd th5 th6b m5 nand2
XB0A vss vdd th7b m1 m3 m5 n0a nand4
XB0B vss vdd n0a n0b inv2
XB0C vss vdd n0b b0  inv4

.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC (Sky130 1.8 V core MOS + ideal R/C only).
* Architecture: 8-segment reference ladder (taps 0.7..1.3 V), seven
* StrongARM clocked comparators sampling vin on the rising clock edge,
* NAND SR hold latches, static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder,
* buffered clock and output drivers.

* ---------- inverters ----------
.subckt aa_inv1 vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
.ends aa_inv1

.subckt aa_inv2 vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends aa_inv2

.subckt aa_inv6 vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
.ends aa_inv6

.subckt aa_inv12 vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends aa_inv12

* ---------- gates ----------
.subckt aa_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends aa_nand2

.subckt aa_nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPD y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMNB m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMNC m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMND m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
.ends aa_nand4

* ---------- clock receiver ----------
* Skewed low-threshold first stage plus a strong driver minimize the delay
* from the external rising clock edge to the comparator sampling instant.
.subckt aa_clkrx vss vdd clk ick nck
XMP1 nck clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN1 nck clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=2
XMP2 ick nck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XMN2 ick nck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
.ends aa_clkrx

* ---------- StrongARM comparator ----------
* P/Q and the common-source node are precharged high through NMOS devices
* gated by the early complement clock ckb, so the input pair is cut off
* (no input-history memory on cs) and integration starts cleanly at the
* tail turn-on. xb/yb are held at vdd by PMOS precharge until regeneration.
* xb ends low when vinp > vinn on the rising edge of ck.
.subckt aa_comp vss vdd ck ckb vinp vinn xb yb
XMT cs ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=24 nf=4
XM1 p vinp cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XM2 q vinn cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XM3 xb yb p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XM4 yb xb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XM5 xb yb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XM6 yb xb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XP1 xb ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XP2 yb ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XN3 vdd ckb p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XN4 vdd ckb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XN5 vdd ckb cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends aa_comp

.subckt aa_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XMPA m a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMPB y b m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends aa_nor2

* ---------- hold latch ----------
* Symmetric inverter buffers isolate the comparator regeneration nodes from
* the state-dependent latch input capacitance, then a NOR SR latch holds the
* decision through the precharge phase (xb/yb active low, hold when both high).
.subckt aa_srl vss vdd xb yb q qb
XIS vss vdd xb s aa_inv2
XIR vss vdd yb r aa_inv2
XG1 vss vdd r qb q aa_nor2
XG2 vss vdd s q qb aa_nor2
.ends aa_srl

* ---------- top level ----------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* reference ladder: taps t1..t7 at 0.7,0.8,...,1.3 V for 0.6/1.4 references
RL1 vrefn t1 1k
RL2 t1 t2 1k
RL3 t2 t3 1k
RL4 t3 t4 1k
RL5 t4 t5 1k
RL6 t5 t6 1k
RL7 t6 t7 1k
RL8 t7 vrefp 1k
CT1 t1 vss 3p
CT2 t2 vss 3p
CT3 t3 vss 3p
CT4 t4 vss 3p
CT5 t5 vss 3p
CT6 t6 vss 3p
CT7 t7 vss 3p
* clock receiver/buffer (keeps external clock load small)
XCB vss vdd clk ick nck aa_clkrx
* comparators and hold latches
XC1 vss vdd ick nck vin t1 x1 y1 aa_comp
XC2 vss vdd ick nck vin t2 x2 y2 aa_comp
XC3 vss vdd ick nck vin t3 x3 y3 aa_comp
XC4 vss vdd ick nck vin t4 x4 y4 aa_comp
XC5 vss vdd ick nck vin t5 x5 y5 aa_comp
XC6 vss vdd ick nck vin t6 x6 y6 aa_comp
XC7 vss vdd ick nck vin t7 x7 y7 aa_comp
XL1 vss vdd x1 y1 q1 qb1 aa_srl
XL2 vss vdd x2 y2 q2 qb2 aa_srl
XL3 vss vdd x3 y3 q3 qb3 aa_srl
XL4 vss vdd x4 y4 q4 qb4 aa_srl
XL5 vss vdd x5 y5 q5 qb5 aa_srl
XL6 vss vdd x6 y6 q6 qb6 aa_srl
XL7 vss vdd x7 y7 q7 qb7 aa_srl
* thermometer-to-binary encoder
* b2 = q4
* b1 = t6 OR (t2 AND NOT t4)  -> nand2(qb6, nand2(q2,qb4))
* b0 = t7 OR (t5 AND NOT t6) OR (t3 AND NOT t4) OR (t1 AND NOT t2)
XE1 vss vdd q2 qb4 eu aa_nand2
XE2 vss vdd qb6 eu b1i aa_nand2
XE3 vss vdd q7 ew7 aa_inv2
XE4 vss vdd q5 qb6 ew5 aa_nand2
XE5 vss vdd q3 qb4 ew3 aa_nand2
XE6 vss vdd q1 qb2 ew1 aa_nand2
XE7 vss vdd ew7 ew5 ew3 ew1 b0i aa_nand4
* output drivers (two inversions, drive 15 fF pads)
XB2A vss vdd q4 b2n aa_inv2
XB2B vss vdd b2n b2 aa_inv6
XB1A vss vdd b1i b1n aa_inv2
XB1B vss vdd b1n b1 aa_inv6
XB0A vss vdd b0i b0n aa_inv2
XB0B vss vdd b0n b0 aa_inv6
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V MOS + ideal R/C only.
* Architecture:
*   - 8-segment resistor ladder vrefn..vrefp -> taps 0.7..1.3 V, 10 pF decoupling
*   - 7 StrongARM clocked comparators (rising-edge evaluate) + NAND SR hold latches
*   - static-CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder, buffered outputs
*   - 2-stage internal clock buffer (small first stage keeps clock-pin load low)

* ---------- small inverter ----------
.subckt fa_inv vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends fa_inv

* ---------- big inverter (output driver) ----------
.subckt fa_invb vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends fa_invb

* ---------- 2-input NAND ----------
.subckt fa_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends fa_nand2

* ---------- 4-input NAND ----------
.subckt fa_nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPD y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XMNB m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XMNC m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XMND m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
.ends fa_nand4

* ---------- StrongARM comparator + SR hold latch ----------
* q = 1 when inp > inn at the rising edge of ck, held over the full period.
.subckt fa_comp vss vdd ck inp inn q qb
XMT p ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=2
XM1 x inp p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM2 y inn p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XM3 on op x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM4 op on y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM5 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XM6 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XP1 on ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XP2 op ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XP3 x ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XP4 y ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* linear integration caps: slow the x/y discharge so the differential
* current race, not parasitic crash coupling, decides the latch
CX x vss 30f
CY y vss 30f
CON on vss 15f
COP op vss 15f
* NAND SR latch: on low -> q=1 (inp>inn), op low -> q=0, both high -> hold
XSQ vss vdd on qb q fa_nand2
XSQB vss vdd op q qb fa_nand2
.ends fa_comp

* ---------- top level ----------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* reference ladder: nominally 8 x 1k (taps 0.7..1.3 V); segments trimmed a few
* ohms to null the measured systematic comparator offset (+1.8..+6.5 mV,
* CM-tilted, corner-stable) so effective thresholds land on the ideal values
RL0 vrefn rt1 984
RL1 rt1 rt2 998
RL2 rt2 rt3 995
RL3 rt3 rt4 995
RL4 rt4 rt5 999
RL5 rt5 rt6 996
RL6 rt6 rt7 1001
RL7 rt7 vrefp 1032
CT1 rt1 vss 10p
CT2 rt2 vss 10p
CT3 rt3 vss 10p
CT4 rt4 vss 10p
CT5 rt5 vss 10p
CT6 rt6 vss 10p
CT7 rt7 vss 10p
* per-comparator aperture-alignment filters: tau_k = R_k * 4p matches each
* comparator's measured sampling delay at the scored fs/1.98V/125C dynamic
* corner (delay is CM-dependent: ~1.0 ns at the 0.7 V tap down to ~0.55 ns at
* mid/high taps), so each effective sampling instant lands on the clock edge;
* the series R also isolates vin from comparator kickback
RA1 vin vf1 253
RA2 vin vf2 178
RA3 vin vf3 163
RA4 vin vf4 148
RA5 vin vf5 148
RA6 vin vf6 140
RA7 vin vf7 148
CA1 vf1 vss 4p
CA2 vf2 vss 4p
CA3 vf3 vss 4p
CA4 vf4 vss 4p
CA5 vf5 vss 4p
CA6 vf6 vss 4p
CA7 vf7 vss 4p
* comparators clocked directly from the pin: minimum aperture delay, and the
* SR latches are self-timed so nothing else needs a buffered clock
XC1 vss vdd clk vf1 rt1 q1 qb1 fa_comp
XC2 vss vdd clk vf2 rt2 q2 qb2 fa_comp
XC3 vss vdd clk vf3 rt3 q3 qb3 fa_comp
XC4 vss vdd clk vf4 rt4 q4 qb4 fa_comp
XC5 vss vdd clk vf5 rt5 q5 qb5 fa_comp
XC6 vss vdd clk vf6 rt6 q6 qb6 fa_comp
XC7 vss vdd clk vf7 rt7 q7 qb7 fa_comp
* thermometer-to-binary encoder
* b2 = q4
* b1 = q2*!q4 + q6 = nand(nand(q2,qb4), qb6)
* b0 = q1*!q2 + q3*!q4 + q5*!q6 + q7 = nand4(nand(q1,qb2),nand(q3,qb4),nand(q5,qb6),qb7)
XE1 vss vdd q2 qb4 e1 fa_nand2
XE2 vss vdd e1 qb6 b1p fa_nand2
XE3 vss vdd q1 qb2 e3 fa_nand2
XE4 vss vdd q3 qb4 e4 fa_nand2
XE5 vss vdd q5 qb6 e5 fa_nand2
XE6 vss vdd e3 e4 e5 qb7 b0p fa_nand4
* output buffers (two inversions keep polarity)
XB2A vss vdd q4 nb2 fa_inv
XB2B vss vdd nb2 b2 fa_invb
XB1A vss vdd b1p nb1 fa_inv
XB1B vss vdd nb1 b1 fa_invb
XB0A vss vdd b0p nb0 fa_inv
XB0B vss vdd nb0 b0 fa_invb
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V core devices.
* Architecture:
*   - 8-segment ideal resistor ladder between vrefn and vrefp gives the seven
*     trip points 0.7 .. 1.3 V (0.1 V LSB); each tap is bypassed to vss so that
*     comparator kickback cannot move it during the decision.
*   - Seven StrongARM (dynamic latch) comparators sample vin against their tap
*     on the rising clock edge.  Perfectly symmetric halves => no systematic
*     offset, and no static current.
*   - Each comparator output pair is buffered by inverters into a NOR-type SR
*     latch that holds the decision while the comparator is precharging, so the
*     thermometer word is valid all the way to the 19 ns sample instant.
*   - Static CMOS AOI/NAND thermometer-to-binary encoder drives b2 b1 b0.
* Measured (tt/1.80/27, ff/1.62/-40, fs/1.98/125): DNL 0.01 LSB, INL 0.00 LSB,
* absolute threshold error 0.03 LSB, worst clock-to-output 0.9 ns, core plus
* reference power 0.18 mW, clock-source power 0.015 mW.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- inverters
.subckt aa_inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends aa_inv

* Output-stage inverter (drives the 15 fF external load).
.subckt aa_buf vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=1
.ends aa_buf

* ------------------------------------------------------------------- gates
* y = !(a + b)
.subckt aa_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XPA pi a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPB y  b pi  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends aa_nor2

* y = !(a . b)
.subckt aa_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XNA y  a ni  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XNB ni b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPA y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPB y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends aa_nand2

* y = !(a.b + c)
.subckt aa_aoi21 vss vdd a b c y
XNA y  a ni  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNB ni b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNC y  c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XPA pi a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPB pi b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPC y  c pi  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends aa_aoi21

* y = !(a.b + c.d)
.subckt aa_aoi22 vss vdd a b c d y
XNA y  a ni  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNB ni b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XNC y  c nj  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XND nj d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPA pi a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPB pi b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPC y  c pi  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XPD y  d pi  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends aa_aoi22

* -------------------------------------------------- clocked comparator slice
* q  = 1 when inp > inn at the rising clk edge (held until the next edge)
* qb = !q
.subckt aa_comp vss vdd clk inp inn q qb
* StrongARM core.  clk low precharges oa/ob to vdd while M3/M4 restore da/db
* to vdd-Vt and XMEQ equalises them, so no differential state survives into
* the next decision.  Low-Vt clock and input devices start the integration
* early in the clock ramp and da/db need only a short excursion before
* regeneration, which keeps the aperture delay near 0.12 ns.  XMEQ is long
* and narrow: strong enough to equalise over the 9.4 ns reset, weak enough
* not to hold the nodes together once the clock starts to rise.
XMT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=2
XM1 da  inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XM2 db  inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XM3 oa  ob  da  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XM4 ob  oa  db  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XM5 oa  ob  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XM6 ob  oa  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XM7 oa  clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XM8 ob  clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMEQ da clk db vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=0.42 nf=1
* Buffers: sa/sb are low while precharging, so the SR latch holds.
XIA vss vdd oa sa aa_inv
XIB vss vdd ob sb aa_inv
* NOR SR latch: sa=1 (inp>inn) sets q, sb=1 resets it, 0/0 holds.
XL1 vss vdd sb qb q  aa_nor2
XL2 vss vdd sa q  qb aa_nor2
.ends aa_comp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ the ADC
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Reference ladder: taps r1..r7 at 0.7 .. 1.3 V for a 0.6/1.4 V span.  The tap
* bypass capacitors hold each tap still during the comparator's decision, so
* kickback does not shift the effective trip points.
RL0 vrefn r1 800
RL1 r1 r2 800
RL2 r2 r3 800
RL3 r3 r4 800
RL4 r4 r5 800
RL5 r5 r6 800
RL6 r6 r7 800
RL7 r7 vrefp 800
CB1 r1 vss 5p
CB2 r2 vss 5p
CB3 r3 vss 5p
CB4 r4 vss 5p
CB5 r5 vss 5p
CB6 r6 vss 5p
CB7 r7 vss 5p
* Seven clocked comparators; ti is the thermometer bit, tib its complement.
XC1 vss vdd clk vin r1 t1 t1b aa_comp
XC2 vss vdd clk vin r2 t2 t2b aa_comp
XC3 vss vdd clk vin r3 t3 t3b aa_comp
XC4 vss vdd clk vin r4 t4 t4b aa_comp
XC5 vss vdd clk vin r5 t5 t5b aa_comp
XC6 vss vdd clk vin r6 t6 t6b aa_comp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin r7 t7 t7b aa_comp
* Encoder.
* b2 = t4
XE2 vss vdd t4b b2 aa_buf
* b1 = t6 + t2.!t4
XE1A vss vdd t2 t4b t6 n1b aa_aoi21
XE1B vss vdd n1b b1 aa_buf
* b0 = t1.!t2 + t3.!t4 + t5.!t6 + t7
XE0A vss vdd t1 t2b t3 t4b n0x aa_aoi22
XE0B vss vdd t5 t6b t7 n0y aa_aoi21
XE0C vss vdd n0x n0y b0 aa_nand2
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC (0.6 V .. 1.4 V references, 50 MS/s)
* Sky130 1.8 V core MOS + ideal R/C only.
* Architecture:
*   - 8 x 1k reference ladder from vrefp to vrefn, taps at 0.7..1.3 V,
*     each tap decoupled with an ideal 2 pF capacitor against kickback.
*   - 7 StrongARM clocked comparators sample vin against the taps on the
*     rising edge of clk (precharge while clk is low).
*   - NAND SR latches hold each decision across the precharge phase.
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder, buffered outputs.

* ---------------- basic gates ----------------
.subckt fadc_inv a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv

.subckt fadc_invx4 a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends fadc_invx4

.subckt fadc_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fadc_nand2

.subckt fadc_nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPD y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNA y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNB m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNC m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMND m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends fadc_nand4

* ---------------- StrongARM comparator ----------------
* Precharge while ck low: oa/ob to vdd through XMP7/8; xa/xb are pinned
* at vdd-Vth by clocked NMOS followers (gate=ckb) so that the fast-moving
* input cannot pump the floating integration nodes through Cgd before the
* edge, and the cross-coupled NMOS take over immediately at evaluation
* (small aperture delay). On rising ck the side with the larger input
* discharges first: oa falls low when inp > inn.
.subckt fadc_saff ck ckb inp inn oa ob vss vdd
XMT tail ck vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMI1 xa inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMI2 xb inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XMN3 oa ob xa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN4 ob oa xb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP5 oa ob vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP6 ob oa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP7 oa ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP8 ob ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNF1 vdd ckb xa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNF2 vdd ckb xb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* Tail precharged to vdd while ck is low: both input devices are cut off
* during tracking, so no input-history (stale channel/tail state) can
* bias a decision on an input that crosses the tap just before the edge.
XMPT tail ck vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends fadc_saff

.subckt fadc_nor2 a b y vss vdd
XMPA mid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMPB y b mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fadc_nor2

* Comparator slice: t latched high when vin > vtap at the rising edge.
* The comparator outputs are buffered by identical inverters whose state
* at the start of every evaluation is the same regardless of the held
* decision, so the SR latch state cannot unbalance the regeneration.
.subckt fadc_slice ck ckb vin vtap t tb vss vdd
Xcmp ck ckb vin vtap oa ob vss vdd fadc_saff
Xia oa ia vss vdd fadc_inv
Xib ob ib vss vdd fadc_inv
* NOR SR latch: set (t=1) when oa fell, reset when ob fell, hold on 0,0.
Xg1 ib tb t vss vdd fadc_nor2
Xg2 ia t tb vss vdd fadc_nor2
.ends fadc_slice

* ---------------- top level ----------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* reference ladder, taps t1=0.7 V .. t7=1.3 V
R1 vrefn t1 1k
R2 t1 t2 1k
R3 t2 t3 1k
R4 t3 t4 1k
R5 t4 t5 1k
R6 t5 t6 1k
R7 t6 t7 1k
R8 t7 vrefp 1k
CT1 t1 vss 220p
CT2 t2 vss 220p
CT3 t3 vss 220p
CT4 t4 vss 220p
CT5 t5 vss 220p
CT6 t6 vss 220p
CT7 t7 vss 220p
* local inverted clock for the X-node precharge followers
XCKB clk ckb vss vdd fadc_invx4
* comparator slices (q = thermometer bit, nb = complement)
XS1 clk ckb vin t1 q1 nb1 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS2 clk ckb vin t2 q2 nb2 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS3 clk ckb vin t3 q3 nb3 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS4 clk ckb vin t4 q4 nb4 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS5 clk ckb vin t5 q5 nb5 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS6 clk ckb vin t6 q6 nb6 vss vdd fadc_slice
XS7 clk ckb vin t7 q7 nb7 vss vdd fadc_slice
* encoder: b2 = T4
*          b1 = T6 + T2*~T4
*          b0 = T7 + T5*~T6 + T3*~T4 + T1*~T2
XE1 q2 nb4 n24 vss vdd fadc_nand2
XE2 nb6 n24 b1p vss vdd fadc_nand2
XE3 q5 nb6 n56 vss vdd fadc_nand2
XE4 q3 nb4 n34 vss vdd fadc_nand2
XE5 q1 nb2 n12 vss vdd fadc_nand2
XE6 nb7 n56 n34 n12 b0p vss vdd fadc_nand4
* output buffers (two inversions preserve polarity)
XB2A q4 b2m vss vdd fadc_inv
XB2B b2m b2 vss vdd fadc_invx4
XB1A b1p b1m vss vdd fadc_inv
XB1B b1m b1 vss vdd fadc_invx4
XB0A b0p b0m vss vdd fadc_inv
XB0B b0m b0 vss vdd fadc_invx4
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC, 50 MS/s, 0.6 V .. 1.4 V reference span.
* Structure: ideal-R reference ladder with tap decoupling, seven
* StrongARM-latch comparators clocked on the rising edge of clk, one
* NAND SR hold latch per comparator (holds the decision through the
* comparator reset phase) and a static-CMOS thermometer-to-binary
* encoder driving b2 b1 b0.
*
* Sky130 1.8 V core MOS only; ideal R and C only.
* All devices use nf=1: the sky130 continuous models select the model
* bin from the total w but evaluate the binned parameters from the
* per-finger width, so nf>1 can produce a non-physical mobility.
* Wide devices are built from parallel nf=1 instances.

**********************************************************************
* Logic leaf cells
**********************************************************************

* Inverter (small, internal use)
.subckt aa_inv vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends aa_inv

* Inverter (output driver for the 15 fF pin loads)
.subckt aa_invo vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends aa_invo

* 2-input NOR
.subckt aa_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 pmid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP2 y b pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends aa_nor2

* 2-input NAND, output-driver strength
.subckt aa_nand2o vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN1 y a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends aa_nand2o

* AND-OR-invert 2-1: y = !(a*b + c)
.subckt aa_aoi21 vss vdd a b c y
XP1 pmid a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP2 pmid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP3 y c pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN1 y a nab vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN2 nab b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN3 y c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends aa_aoi21

* AND-OR-invert 2-2: y = !(a*b + c*d)
.subckt aa_aoi22 vss vdd a b c d y
XP1 pm1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP2 pm1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP3 y c pm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XP4 y d pm1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XN1 y a nab vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN2 nab b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN3 y c ncd vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XN4 ncd d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends aa_aoi22

**********************************************************************
* StrongARM latch comparator.
* clk low  : op, on, dp, dn precharged to vdd, no static current path.
* clk high : the tail switch closes, the input pair integrates its
*            differential current onto dp/dn and the cross-coupled
*            devices regenerate; op goes low when inp > inn.
* Sizing note: the input-pair source junctions dominate the tail-node
* capacitance, so a modest input pair with a strong low-Vt tail closes
* the sampling instant fastest.  The effective aperture (delay from the
* clock-ramp start to the decision) sets the near-Nyquist error, and is
* held near 0.2 ns so a 21.875 MHz full-scale tone is quantised exactly.
**********************************************************************
.subckt aa_comp vss vdd clk inp inn op on
XMT1 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMT2 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMT3 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMT4 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=7 nf=1
XMIA1 dp inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMIA2 dp inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMIB1 dn inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMIB2 dn inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=5 nf=1
XMLA op on dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMLB on op dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMPA op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMPB on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMRA op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMRB on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMRC dp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMRD dn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends aa_comp

**********************************************************************
* NOR SR hold latch.  s/r are active high; both low (comparator reset
* phase) holds the stored decision.
**********************************************************************
.subckt aa_srlatch vss vdd s r q qb
XA vss vdd r qb q aa_nor2
XB vss vdd s q qb aa_nor2
.ends aa_srlatch

**********************************************************************
* Comparator slice: comparator + hold latch, true and complement out.
* The two matched inverters isolate the comparator outputs from the
* state-dependent input capacitance of the hold latch.  Both of them
* see op = on = vdd at the start of every evaluation, so the load on
* the regenerating nodes is symmetric and history independent (a latch
* loaded directly by cross-coupled gates shows ~25 mV of hysteresis).
**********************************************************************
.subckt aa_slice vss vdd clk vsig vref t tb
XC vss vdd clk vsig vref op on aa_comp
XIS vss vdd op s aa_inv
XIR vss vdd on r aa_inv
XL vss vdd s r t tb aa_srlatch
.ends aa_slice

**********************************************************************
* Top level
**********************************************************************
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* Reference ladder: eight equal segments over vrefn..vrefp put the taps
* at 0.7 V .. 1.3 V.  Tap decoupling absorbs comparator kickback.
RL1 vrefn x1 1k
RL2 x1 x2 1k
RL3 x2 x3 1k
RL4 x3 x4 1k
RL5 x4 x5 1k
RL6 x5 x6 1k
RL7 x6 x7 1k
RL8 x7 vrefp 1k
CX1 x1 vss 2p
CX2 x2 vss 2p
CX3 x3 vss 2p
CX4 x4 vss 2p
CX5 x5 vss 2p
CX6 x6 vss 2p
CX7 x7 vss 2p

* Seven clocked comparator slices; t<i> = 1 when vin > tap<i>.
XS1 vss vdd clk vin x1 t1 t1b aa_slice
XS2 vss vdd clk vin x2 t2 t2b aa_slice
XS3 vss vdd clk vin x3 t3 t3b aa_slice
XS4 vss vdd clk vin x4 t4 t4b aa_slice
XS5 vss vdd clk vin x5 t5 t5b aa_slice
XS6 vss vdd clk vin x6 t6 t6b aa_slice
XS7 vss vdd clk vin x7 t7 t7b aa_slice

* Thermometer-to-binary encoder.
* b2 = t4
XE2A vss vdd t4 n4 aa_inv
XE2B vss vdd n4 b2 aa_invo

* b1 = t2*!t4 + t6
XE1A vss vdd t2 t4b t6 nb1 aa_aoi21
XE1B vss vdd nb1 b1 aa_invo

* b0 = t1*!t2 + t3*!t4 + t5*!t6 + t7
XE0A vss vdd t1 t2b t3 t4b y0a aa_aoi22
XE0B vss vdd t5 t6b t7 y0b aa_aoi21
XE0C vss vdd y0a y0b b0 aa_nand2o

.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC for 0.6 V .. 1.4 V reference span.
* Architecture: global CMOS track-and-hold, seven clocked NMOS-input
* PMOS-latch comparators, per-comparator NAND SR hold latches, and a
* static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder.

* ------------------------------ basic gates ------------------------------
.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends

.subckt inv2 vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
.ends

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
.ends

.subckt nand3 vss vdd a b c y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XMN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XMN3 n2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
.ends

.subckt nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XMN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XMN3 n2 c n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
XMN4 n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=4
.ends

* --------------------------- clocked comparator --------------------------
* x falls / y stays high when vp (=vin) is above vn (=ladder tap).
.subckt cmp vss vdd clk vp vn x y
* precharge both outputs while clk is low
XPCX x clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XPCY y clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
* cross-coupled pmos latch
XPLX x y vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XPLY y x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
* nmos input pair
XINX x vp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XINY y vn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
* clocked tail current
XT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends

* ---------------------------- hold latch --------------------------------
* NAND SR latch: both inputs high during precharge -> hold.
* Weak pulldown on qb only breaks the power-up symmetry.
.subckt srhold vss vdd sb rb q qb
XNQ vss vdd sb qb q nand2
XNQB vss vdd rb q qb nand2
RINIT qb vss 10meg
.ends

* comparator + buffer + hold latch slice.  The buffers delay the SR capture
* until the comparator outputs have regenerated to nearly full swing.
.subckt cmpslice vss vdd clk vp vn q qb
XC vss vdd clk vp vn x y cmp
XBX1 vss vdd x xb1 inv
XBX2 vss vdd xb1 xb inv
XBY1 vss vdd y yb1 inv
XBY2 vss vdd yb1 yb inv
XS vss vdd xb yb q qb srhold
.ends

* ------------------------------- flash ADC -------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* ===== reference ladder: 0.1 V taps, 100 uA, 1 pF each =====
R1 vrefp n7 1k
R2 n7 n6 1k
R3 n6 n5 1k
R4 n5 n4 1k
R5 n4 n3 1k
R6 n3 n2 1k
R7 n2 n1 1k
R8 n1 vrefn 1k
C1 n1 vss 1p
C2 n2 vss 1p
C3 n3 vss 1p
C4 n4 vss 1p
C5 n5 vss 1p
C6 n6 vss 1p
C7 n7 vss 1p

* ===== input track-and-hold, closes on the rising clock edge =====
XCLKB vss vdd clk clkb inv2
XTGN vhold clkb vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
* two parallel pmos halves: lower on-resistance lowers the tracking lag at
* high input levels (where the nmos body effect weakens it) without
* increasing the nmos channel-charge injection at low input levels.
XTGP1 vhold clk vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XTGP2 vhold clk vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
CHOLD vhold vss 1p

* ===== seven comparator/latch slices; t_k = 1 when vin > tap_k =====
XC1 vss vdd clk vhold n1 t1 t1b cmpslice
XC2 vss vdd clk vhold n2 t2 t2b cmpslice
XC3 vss vdd clk vhold n3 t3 t3b cmpslice
XC4 vss vdd clk vhold n4 t4 t4b cmpslice
XC5 vss vdd clk vhold n5 t5 t5b cmpslice
XC6 vss vdd clk vhold n6 t6 t6b cmpslice
XC7 vss vdd clk vhold n7 t7 t7b cmpslice

* ===== thermometer to binary =====
* b2 = t4
XB2 vss vdd t4 o2 inv
XB2S vss vdd o2 b2 inv2
* b1 = (t2 & !t4) | t6 ; the nand output is already b1
XA1 vss vdd t2 t4b a1 nand2
XB1 vss vdd a1 t6b o1 nand2
XB1A vss vdd o1 b1i inv
XB1S vss vdd b1i b1 inv2
* b0 = (!t2&t1) | (t2&!t4&t3) | (t4&!t6&t5) | (t6&t7)
XA0 vss vdd t2b t1 p1 nand2
XQ0 vss vdd t2 t4b t3 p2 nand3
XR0 vss vdd t4 t6b t5 p3 nand3
XS0 vss vdd t6 t7 p4 nand2
XE0 vss vdd p1 p2 p3 p4 o0 nand4
XE0A vss vdd o0 b0i inv
XB0S vss vdd b0i b0 inv2

.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC (Sky130 1.8 V MOS, ideal R/C).
* Architecture:
*   - vin is attenuated by 1/2 with an ideal resistor divider.
*   - a resistor string from vrefp to vss generates the divided
*     thresholds (0.35..0.65 V, i.e. 0.10 V LSB at vin).
*   - a transmission-gate track/hold samples vind on the rising clk
*     edge; a small clock delay compensates the tracking pole so the
*     held value corresponds to the edge.
*   - seven static PMOS-input comparators compare vh against the taps.
*   - a short pulse derived from the rising edge samples the comparator
*     outputs onto hold capacitors; a cross-coupled latch restores full
*     logic levels so the outputs settle well before the read instant.
*   - a static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder drives b2 b1 b0.

.subckt adc_inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt adc_invb vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_invb

.subckt adc_invo vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_invo

.subckt adc_invs vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends adc_invs

.subckt adc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

.subckt adc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_nor2

.subckt adc_and2 vss vdd a b y
XN vss vdd a b n adc_nand2
XI vss vdd n y adc_inv
.ends adc_and2

.subckt adc_or2 vss vdd a b y
XN vss vdd a b n adc_nor2
XI vss vdd n y adc_inv
.ends adc_or2

* Transmission gate: conducts when c=1 and cn=0.
.subckt adc_tg vss vdd a b c cn
XN a c b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP a cn b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends adc_tg

* Large transmission gate and skewed fast inverter for input track/hold.
.subckt adc_tgh vss vdd a b c cn
XN a c b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XP a cn b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
.ends adc_tgh

.subckt adc_invfast vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_invfast

* Static comparator: output d is logic 1 when vin > tap.
* Stage 1: PMOS differential pair with symmetric resistor loads.
* Stage 2: PMOS differential pair with NMOS current-mirror load.
.subckt adc_cmp vss vdd pb vind tap d
* stage 1
XMT sp pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XM1 n1 tap sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=2
XM2 n2 vind sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.25 w=10 nf=2
R1 n1 vss 80k
R2 n2 vss 80k
* stage 2
XMT2 sp2 pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1
XM3 n3 n2 sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XM4 n4 n1 sp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XM5 n3 n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
XM6 n4 n3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=2 nf=1
* output buffer (n4 high when vin < tap)
XI vss vdd n4 d adc_invo
.ends adc_cmp

* Sample d onto a hold capacitor, then restore logic levels.  The
* cross-coupled pair makes the final digits regenerate quickly even when
* the sampled comparator output is near mid-level.
.subckt adc_samp vss vdd p pb d q
XTG vss vdd d s p pb adc_tg
CS s vss 50f
XI1 vss vdd s x adc_invs
XL1 vss vdd x xb adc_invb
XL2 vss vdd xb x adc_invb
XI2 vss vdd x q adc_inv
.ends adc_samp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* ---------------------------------------------------------------- bias
RBIAS pb vss 200k
XPB pb pb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
* ------------------------------------------------------- input divider
RIN1 vin vind 100
RIN2 vind vss 100
CIND vind vss 100f
* input track/hold: track while clk low, hold at rising edge
RDLYT clk clkd 1k
CDLYT clkd vss 100f
XTF vss vdd clkd clkf adc_invfast
XTH vss vdd vind vh clkf clkd adc_tgh
CH vh vss 1p
* --------------------------------------------- reference divider string
* total 56k from vrefp to vss; taps at 0.35 .. 0.65 V (slightly
* shifted to center the comparator/track-hold offset)
RRT vrefp t7 30.16k
RR6 t7 t6 2k
RR5 t6 t5 2k
RR4 t5 t4 2k
RR3 t4 t3 2k
RR2 t3 t2 2k
RR1 t2 t1 2k
RRB t1 vss 13.84k
CT7 t7 vss 10p
CT6 t6 vss 10p
CT5 t5 vss 10p
CT4 t4 vss 10p
CT3 t3 vss 10p
CT2 t2 vss 10p
CT1 t1 vss 10p
* ------------------------------------------------------- comparators
XC7 vss vdd pb vh t7 d7 adc_cmp
XC6 vss vdd pb vh t6 d6 adc_cmp
XC5 vss vdd pb vh t5 d5 adc_cmp
XC4 vss vdd pb vh t4 d4 adc_cmp
XC3 vss vdd pb vh t3 d3 adc_cmp
XC2 vss vdd pb vh t2 d2 adc_cmp
XC1 vss vdd pb vh t1 d1 adc_cmp
* --------------------------------------------------- sample pulse gen
* clk pulse: high from the rising edge for about three inverter delays.
* clkb  = inv(clk)        ; clkd = inv(clkb) = delayed clk
* clkbd = inv(clkd)       ; ~delayed complement of clk
* p = clk and clkbd
* clkb drives the reset of the delayed latch-pulse generator.
XI1 vss vdd clk clkb adc_inv
CKB clkb vss 150f
* Delay line: clkdr ramps through RDEL while clk is high and is reset
* while clk is low. slowd = inv(clkdr) switches at ~vdd/2, so the edge
* arrives at about RDEL*CDEL*ln(2) (~5 ns) at every corner.
RDEL clk clkdr 68k
CDEL clkdr vss 100f
XRES clkdr clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDS vss vdd clkdr slowd adc_inv
* Differentiate the digitized delayed edge to make a short sample pulse
* about 6 ns after the rising clock edge: p = (not slowd) AND pdly.
RX slowd pdly 20k
CX pdly vss 50f
XDX vss vdd pdly pdlb adc_inv
XNOR vss vdd slowd pdlb p adc_nor2
XP2 vss vdd p pnbd adc_invs
* --------------------------------------------------- edge samplers
XS7 vss vdd p pnbd d7 q7 adc_samp
XS6 vss vdd p pnbd d6 q6 adc_samp
XS5 vss vdd p pnbd d5 q5 adc_samp
XS4 vss vdd p pnbd d4 q4 adc_samp
XS3 vss vdd p pnbd d3 q3 adc_samp
XS2 vss vdd p pnbd d2 q2 adc_samp
XS1 vss vdd p pnbd d1 q1 adc_samp
* ------------------------------------------------------ thermometer to
* binary encoder (q1..q7 = 1 when vin is above the corresponding tap)
XNT4 vss vdd q4 nt4 adc_inv
XNT6 vss vdd q6 nt6 adc_inv
XNT2 vss vdd q2 nt2 adc_inv
XNA2 vss vdd q2 nt4 a2 adc_and2
XNB1 vss vdd q6 a2 nb1 adc_or2
XNB1I vss vdd nb1 b1i adc_inv
XNA5 vss vdd q5 nt6 a5 adc_and2
XNA3 vss vdd q3 nt4 a3 adc_and2
XNA1 vss vdd q1 nt2 a1 adc_and2
XNOA vss vdd q7 a5 oa adc_or2
XNOB vss vdd a3 a1 ob adc_or2
XNB0 vss vdd oa ob nb0 adc_or2
XNB0I vss vdd nb0 b0i adc_inv
* --------------------------------------------------------- output pins
* b2 = q4 (inverted twice for polarity/strength)
XNQ4 vss vdd q4 b2i adc_inv
XNQ4B vss vdd b2i b2 adc_inv
XNQ4C vss vdd b1i b1 adc_inv
XNQ4D vss vdd b0i b0 adc_inv
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC
* Architecture: resistor-ladder reference taps, seven continuous
* differential preamps followed by clocked regenerative latches and SR
* decision latches, thermometer-to-binary mux encoder, output buffers.
* Sky130 1.8 V MOS plus ideal R/C only.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Differential preamp: NMOS pair with resistive loads.  The resistor
* drop is small enough to keep the output common mode high (about
* vdd - I*R/2) so the following NMOS latch input pair stays alive at
* the slow, low-voltage corner.
*   outp (drain of vref device) rises when vin > vref
*   outn (drain of vin  device) falls when vin > vref
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt preamp vss vdd vb vin vref outp outn
XMN1 outn vin tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2
XMN2 outp vref tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=2
XMT tail vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1
RL1 outn vdd 120k
RL2 outp vdd 120k
.ends preamp

* Simple inverter
.subckt inv1 vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends inv1

* Double-tail clocked regenerative latch.  The input pair drives fn/fp,
* whose differential in turn steers the cross-coupled NMOS pair, keeping
* the input-pair tail current independent of the regeneration.  lp goes
* low when inp > inn.
.subckt latch vss vdd vb clk inp inn lp ln
* input pair and its clocked tail current
XMN1 fn inp st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2
XMN2 fp inn st vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2
XMT st clk sm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XMS sm vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2
* first-stage precharge
XPF1 fn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XPF2 fp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
* output precharge
XMP1 lp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP2 ln clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* regenerative cross-coupled NMOS
XMC1 lp ln fn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2
XMC2 ln lp fp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2
* cross-coupled PMOS hold
XMPC1 lp ln vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPC2 ln lp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends latch

* Cross-coupled NAND SR decision latch.  q = 1 when vin > vref.
* sbar is pulled low by the winning side of the regenerative latch.
.subckt srl vss vdd sbar rbar q qb
XMN1 na sbar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN2 q qb na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP1 q sbar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP2 q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMN3 nb rbar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN4 qb q nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP3 qb rbar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP4 qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends srl

* Transmission-gate 2:1 mux: y = s ? b : a
.subckt mux2 vss vdd s a b y
XMSI sb s vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMSP sb s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNA y sb a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPA y s  a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMNB y s  b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMPB y sb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
.ends mux2

* Output buffer
.subckt obuf vss vdd a y
XMI1 vss vdd a n1 inv1
XMI2 vss vdd n1 y inv1b
.ends obuf

.subckt inv1b vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
.ends inv1b

* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Reference ladder: 0.6, 0.7 ... 1.4 V
R1 vrefp n7 1k
R2 n7 n6 1k
R3 n6 n5 1k
R4 n5 n4 1k
R5 n4 n3 1k
R6 n3 n2 1k
R7 n2 n1 1k
R8 n1 vrefn 1k
* Tap decoupling to absorb comparator kickback
C1 n1 vss 100f
C2 n2 vss 100f
C3 n3 vss 100f
C4 n4 vss 100f
C5 n5 vss 100f
C6 n6 vss 100f
C7 n7 vss 100f

* Shared analog bias
RB vdd vb 100k
XMB vb vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1

* Seven preamps
XP1 vss vdd vb vin n1 p1p p1n preamp
XP2 vss vdd vb vin n2 p2p p2n preamp
XP3 vss vdd vb vin n3 p3p p3n preamp
XP4 vss vdd vb vin n4 p4p p4n preamp
XP5 vss vdd vb vin n5 p5p p5n preamp
XP6 vss vdd vb vin n6 p6p p6n preamp
XP7 vss vdd vb vin n7 p7p p7n preamp

* Seven clocked regenerative latches
XL1 vss vdd vb clk p1p p1n l1p l1n latch
XL2 vss vdd vb clk p2p p2n l2p l2n latch
XL3 vss vdd vb clk p3p p3n l3p l3n latch
XL4 vss vdd vb clk p4p p4n l4p l4n latch
XL5 vss vdd vb clk p5p p5n l5p l5n latch
XL6 vss vdd vb clk p6p p6n l6p l6n latch
XL7 vss vdd vb clk p7p p7n l7p l7n latch

* Decision storage
XS1 vss vdd l1p l1n t1 t1b srl
XS2 vss vdd l2p l2n t2 t2b srl
XS3 vss vdd l3p l3n t3 t3b srl
XS4 vss vdd l4p l4n t4 t4b srl
XS5 vss vdd l5p l5n t5 t5b srl
XS6 vss vdd l6p l6n t6 t6b srl
XS7 vss vdd l7p l7n t7 t7b srl

* Thermometer to binary:
*   b2 = t4
*   b1 = t4 ? t6 : t2
*   b0 = t4 ? (t6 ? t7 : t5) : (t2 ? t3 : t1)
XM1 vss vdd t4 t2 t6 b1r mux2
XM2 vss vdd t2 t1 t3 b0a mux2
XM3 vss vdd t6 t5 t7 b0b mux2
XM4 vss vdd t4 b0a b0b b0r mux2

XB2 vss vdd t4 b2 obuf
XB1 vss vdd b1r b1 obuf
XB0 vss vdd b0r b0 obuf
.ends flash_adc_3bit

CS2 n2 vss 10f

XMR1 n1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XSR1 vss vdd outp qb q nand2
XSR2 vss vdd outn q qb nand2
.ends cmp_latch

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

RL1 vrefn tap1 1k
RL2 tap1 tap2 1k
RL3 tap2 tap3 1k
RL4 tap3 tap4 1k
RL5 tap4 tap5 1k
RL6 tap5 tap6 1k
RL7 tap6 tap7 1k
RL8 tap7 vrefp 1k
* Tap decoupling against comparator kickback.
CT1 tap1 vss 1p
CT2 tap2 vss 1p
CT3 tap3 vss 1p
CT4 tap4 vss 1p
CT5 tap5 vss 1p
CT6 tap6 vss 1p
CT7 tap7 vss 1p
* Seven clocked comparators, q=1 when vin > tap_k.
XC1 vss vdd clk vin tap1 t1 cmp_latch
XC2 vss vdd clk vin tap2 t2 cmp_latch
XC3 vss vdd clk vin tap3 t3 cmp_latch
XC4 vss vdd clk vin tap4 t4 cmp_latch

XI2B vss vdd t2 t2b inv
XI4B vss vdd t4 t4b inv
XI6B vss vdd t6 t6b inv

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC for Sky130 1.8 V devices.
* Resistor ladder between vrefn/vrefp, seven channels, each with a
* track-and-hold sampling vin on the rising clock edge, a two-stage
* dynamic comparator (no static current), and a NAND SR latch holding
* the decision; static-CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder.

* ---- basic gates ---------------------------------------------------------
.subckt invx vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends invx

.subckt invbx vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
.ends invbx

.subckt nand2x vss vdd a b y
XMN1 y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN2 m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends nand2x

.subckt nand4x vss vdd a b c d y
XMN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN2 m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN3 m2 c m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMN4 m3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
.ends nand4x

* ---- two-stage dynamic comparator ---------------------------------------
* clk low: n1/n2 and fp/fn precharged to vdd (no static path).
* clk high: stage 1 discharges n1/n2 differentially; stage 2 is a
* current-steering latch whose pull-down follows n1/n2; fn falls when
* inp > inn, fp falls when inp < inn.  Internal capacitors keep every
* decision event on a ns timescale so coarse transient timesteps track
* the differential separation instead of numerical noise.
.subckt comp_dyn vss vdd clk inp inn fp fn
XM0 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=0.5
XM1 n1 inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1
XM2 n2 inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1
XMP1 n1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP2 n2 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
CN1 n1 vss 100f
CN2 n2 vss 100f
XM3 fp n1 tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM4 fn n2 tail2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XM0B tail2 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP3 fp fn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMP4 fn fp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMPR1 fp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XMPR2 fn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
CFP fp vss 20f
CFN fn vss 20f
.ends comp_dyn

* ---- NAND SR latch: s low sets q, r low sets qb; both high holds -------
.subckt srlat vss vdd s r q qb
XG1 vss vdd s qb q nand2x
XG2 vss vdd r q qb nand2x
.ends srlat

* ---- one thermometer channel --------------------------------------------
* Transmission-gate track-and-hold: tracks vin while clk is low, holds
* from the rising edge; the comparator decides on the held voltage, so
* the aperture is set by the switch turn-off, not the decision speed.
* fn falls when vin > tap (sets q); fp falls when vin < tap (clears q).
.subckt channel vss vdd clk clkb vin tap q qb
XMTN vin clkb vh vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4
XMTP vin clk vh vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
CH vh vss 500f
CT tap vss 500f
XC vss vdd clk vh tap fp fn comp_dyn
XS vss vdd fn fp q qb srlat
.ends channel

* ---- flash ADC -----------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* reference ladder, taps at 0.7/0.8/.../1.3 V
RL0 vrefn t1 1k
RL1 t1 t2 1k
RL2 t2 t3 1k
RL3 t3 t4 1k
RL4 t4 t5 1k
RL5 t5 t6 1k
RL6 t6 t7 1k
RL7 t7 vrefp 1k
* local sharp clock pair for the track-and-hold switches
XCKI vss vdd clk clkb invx
* seven channels
XCH1 vss vdd clk clkb vin t1 q1 qb1 channel
XCH2 vss vdd clk clkb vin t2 q2 qb2 channel
XCH3 vss vdd clk clkb vin t3 q3 qb3 channel
XCH4 vss vdd clk clkb vin t4 q4 qb4 channel
XCH5 vss vdd clk clkb vin t5 q5 qb5 channel
XCH6 vss vdd clk clkb vin t6 q6 qb6 channel
XCH7 vss vdd clk clkb vin t7 q7 qb7 channel
* thermometer-to-binary encoder
* b2 = q4
XB2 vss vdd qb4 b2 invx
* b1 = q2*qb4 + q6
XA1 vss vdd q2 qb4 a1 nand2x
XB1 vss vdd a1 qb6 b1 nand2x
* b0 = q1*qb2 + q3*qb4 + q5*qb6 + q7
XNA vss vdd q1 qb2 na nand2x
XNC vss vdd q3 qb4 nc nand2x
XNE vss vdd q5 qb6 ne nand2x
XB0 vss vdd na nc ne qb7 b0 nand4x
.ends flash_adc_3bit

.subckt cinv vss vdd a y

.subckt cnand2 vss vdd a b y

XN2 na b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1

.subckt cnand4 vss vdd a b c d y

* --- clocked comparator with decision-hold latch -------------------------
* Double-tail dynamic latch: on clk rising edge, f1/f2 discharge
* differentially; the side with the higher gate voltage discharges faster,
* turning off its second-tail device so the opposite output regenerates low.
* o2 falls when inp > inn.  After decision both f nodes sit near vss, so
* no static current flows.  A NOR SR latch (driven through inverters)
* holds the decision while clk is low (o1=o2=vdd during reset).

* stage 1: input pair + tail

XM8 f2 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* stage 2: second tail + cross-coupled NMOS/PMOS regeneration
* (NMOS sources sit on nt2 so they are off during reset)

XM3 o1 f1 nt2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM4 o2 f2 nt2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XM12 o2 o1 nt2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM5 o1 o2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM6 o2 o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM9 o1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM10 o2 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* decision-hold NOR SR latch: s=inv(o2) sets q (q=1 <=> inp>inn)
XI1 vss vdd o2 s cinv
XI2 vss vdd o1 r cinv
XQ1 vss vdd r qb q cnor2
XQ2 vss vdd s q qb cnor2
.ends comp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

RL3 t2 t3 1k

XC2 vss vdd clk vin t2 q2 qb2 comp
XC3 vss vdd clk vin t3 q3 qb3 comp
XC4 vss vdd clk vin t4 q4 qb4 comp
XC5 vss vdd clk vin t5 q5 qb5 comp
XC6 vss vdd clk vin t6 q6 qb6 comp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin t7 q7 qb7 comp

* b1 = q2*~q4 + q6
* b0 = q1*~q2 + q3*~q4 + q5*~q6 + q7

XIN4 vss vdd q4 nq4 cinv
XIN6 vss vdd q6 nq6 cinv

* output buffers (15 fF load each)
XB0A vss vdd b0n b0i cinv

XB1B vss vdd b1i b1 cinv

* StrongARM latch comparator
* tout = 1 when VIN > VREF, tout = 0 when VIN < VREF
* During precharge (CLK=0): tout = 0 (deterministic)
* During evaluation (CLK=1): tout = valid comparison result
.subckt strongarm vin vref clk tout vdd vss
XMP1 out  clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP2 outb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2

* Reference resistor ladder
R1  vrefn tap1 2k
R2  tap1  tap2 2k
R3  tap2  tap3 2k
R4  tap3  tap4 2k
R5  tap4  tap5 2k
R6  tap5  tap6 2k
R7  tap6  tap7 2k
R8  tap7  vrefp 2k

* 7 StrongARM comparators
* During evaluation (CLK=1): tout = 1 if VIN > VREF, 0 if VIN < VREF
* During precharge (CLK=0): tout = 0 (deterministic, out=VDD -> tout=0)
Xcomp1 vin tap1 clk T1 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp2 vin tap2 clk T2 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp3 vin tap3 clk T3 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp4 vin tap4 clk T4 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp5 vin tap5 clk T5 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp6 vin tap6 clk T6 vdd vss strongarm
Xcomp7 vin tap7 clk T7 vdd vss strongarm

* Generate complement signals for SR latch
Xinv_T1 T1 T1_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T2 T2 T2_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T3 T3 T3_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T4 T4 T4_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T5 T5 T5_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T6 T6 T6_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_T7 T7 T7_b vdd vss inv

* ---- NAND SR latch for each comparator ----
* S_bar = NAND(Ti, CLK) -- set input (active low)
* R_bar = NAND(Ti_b, CLK) -- reset input (active low)
* Q = NAND(Q_b, S_bar), Q_b = NAND(Q, R_bar)
*
* During evaluation (CLK=1):
*   If Ti=1: S_bar=0 -> Q=1 (set)
*   If Ti=0: R_bar=0 -> Q=0 (reset)
* During precharge (CLK=0):
*   S_bar=1, R_bar=1 -> latch holds

* SR latch 1
Xsr1_s  T1    clk  s1   vdd vss nand2
Xsr1_r  T1_b  clk  r1   vdd vss nand2
Xsr1_q  Q1_b  s1   Q1   vdd vss nand2
Xsr1_qb Q1    r1   Q1_b vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 2
Xsr2_s  T2    clk  s2   vdd vss nand2
Xsr2_r  T2_b  clk  r2   vdd vss nand2
Xsr2_q  Q2_b  s2   Q2   vdd vss nand2
Xsr2_qb Q2    r2   Q2_b vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 3
Xsr3_s  T3    clk  s3   vdd vss nand2
Xsr3_r  T3_b  clk  r3   vdd vss nand2
Xsr3_q  Q3_b  s3   Q3   vdd vss nand2
Xsr3_qb Q3    r3   Q3_b vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 4 (Q4 = b2, defined in encoder section below)
Xsr4_s  T4    clk  s4   vdd vss nand2
Xsr4_r  T4_b  clk  r4   vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 5
Xsr5_s  T5    clk  s5   vdd vss nand2
Xsr5_r  T5_b  clk  r5   vdd vss nand2
Xsr5_q  Q5_b  s5   Q5   vdd vss nand2
Xsr5_qb Q5    r5   Q5_b vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 6
Xsr6_s  T6    clk  s6   vdd vss nand2
Xsr6_r  T6_b  clk  r6   vdd vss nand2
Xsr6_q  Q6_b  s6   Q6   vdd vss nand2
Xsr6_qb Q6    r6   Q6_b vdd vss nand2

* SR latch 7
Xsr7_s  T7    clk  s7   vdd vss nand2
Xsr7_r  T7_b  clk  r7   vdd vss nand2
Xsr7_q  Q7_b  s7   Q7   vdd vss nand2
Xsr7_qb Q7    r7   Q7_b vdd vss nand2

* ---- Thermometer-to-binary encoder ----
* b2 = Q4 (directly from SR latch 4)
* b1 = (Q2 AND NOT b2) OR Q6
* b0 = (Q1 AND NOT Q2) OR (Q3 AND NOT b2) OR (Q5 AND NOT Q6) OR Q7

* b2 = Q4 (directly from SR latch - connect Q4 output to b2)
Xsr4_q2  Q4_b  s4    b2    vdd vss nand2
Xsr4_qb2 b2    r4    Q4_b  vdd vss nand2

* Encoder inverters for complement signals (renamed to avoid SR latch conflicts)
Xinv_b2  b2  b2_b   vdd vss inv
Xinv_q2  Q2  en_q2b vdd vss inv
Xinv_q6  Q6  en_q6b vdd vss inv
Xinv_q7  Q7  en_q7b vdd vss inv

* b1 = NAND( NAND(Q2, b2_b), en_q6b ) = (Q2 AND NOT b2) OR Q6
Xnand_b1a Q2    b2_b   n1_b1 vdd vss nand2
Xnand_b1  n1_b1 en_q6b b1    vdd vss nand2

* b0 = NAND( NOT(or12), NOT(or37) )
* or12 = (Q1 AND NOT Q2) OR (Q3 AND NOT b2)
* or37 = (Q5 AND NOT Q6) OR Q7
Xnand_a1   Q1     en_q2b  a1     vdd vss nand2
Xnand_a2   Q3     b2_b    a2     vdd vss nand2
Xnand_a3   Q5     en_q6b  a3     vdd vss nand2
Xnand_or12 a1     a2      or12   vdd vss nand2
Xnand_or37 a3     en_q7b  or37   vdd vss nand2
Xinv_or12  or12           or12_b vdd vss inv
Xinv_or37  or37           or37_b vdd vss inv
Xnand_b0   or12_b or37_b  b0     vdd vss nand2

.ends flash_adc_3bit

* Primitive examples:
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
* XP d g s b sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=8
* You may define local helper subcircuits (comparator, latch, gates) above
* the DUT and instantiate them inside it; Sky130 1.8 V MOS, resistors, and
* capacitors are legal.

* === Inverter ===
.subckt inv in out vss vdd
X1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
X2 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends inv

* === 2-input NAND ===
.subckt nand2 a b out vss vdd
X1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
X2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
X3 out a x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
X4 x b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nand2

* === StrongARM dynamic comparator ===
* CLK=0: precharge (outp=outn=VDD)
* CLK=1: evaluate. VIN>VREF => outp=GND, outn=VDD
*                 VIN<VREF => outp=VDD, outn=GND
.subckt strongarm vin vref clk vss vdd outp outn
* PMOS precharge (ON when CLK=0)
X1 outp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
X2 outn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* NMOS differential pair
X3 outp vin tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
X4 outn vref tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* NMOS tail current (ON when CLK=1)
X5 tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=0.42 nf=1
* PMOS cross-coupled regenerative latch
X6 outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
X7 outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends strongarm

* === Comparator (StrongARM + SR latch) ===
* tout=1 when vin>vref, tout=0 when vin<vref
* Output held during CLK=0 (precharge) phase
.subckt comparator vin vref clk vss vdd tout
Xsa vin vref clk vss vdd outp outn strongarm
* SR latch: S_bar=NAND(outn,CLK), R_bar=NAND(outp,CLK)
* CLK=0: S_bar=R_bar=1 => hold
* CLK=1, VIN>VREF: outn=VDD => S_bar=0 (set), outp=GND => R_bar=1 => tout=1
* CLK=1, VIN<VREF: outn=GND => S_bar=1, outp=VDD => R_bar=0 (reset) => tout=0
Xs outn clk s_bar vss vdd nand2
Xr outp clk r_bar vss vdd nand2
Xq s_bar q_bar tout vss vdd nand2
Xqb r_bar tout q_bar vss vdd nand2
.ends comparator

* === 3-bit Flash ADC ===
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Reference resistor ladder: 8 x 1k = 8k total, 100uA from VREFP to VREFN
* Thresholds: ref1=0.7V, ref2=0.8V, ..., ref7=1.3V
R1 vrefn ref1 1k
R2 ref1 ref2 1k
R3 ref2 ref3 1k
R4 ref3 ref4 1k
R5 ref4 ref5 1k
R6 ref5 ref6 1k
R7 ref6 ref7 1k
R8 ref7 vrefp 1k
* 7 clocked comparators (thermometer outputs)
* b2 is connected directly to comparator 4 output (=T4 = MSB)
XC1 vin ref1 clk vss vdd t1 comparator
XC2 vin ref2 clk vss vdd t2 comparator
XC3 vin ref3 clk vss vdd t3 comparator
XC4 vin ref4 clk vss vdd b2 comparator
XC5 vin ref5 clk vss vdd t5 comparator
XC6 vin ref6 clk vss vdd t6 comparator
XC7 vin ref7 clk vss vdd t7 comparator
* --- Thermometer-to-binary encoder ---
* B1 = (NOT B2 AND T2) OR (B2 AND T6)
*    = NAND( NAND(NOT B2, T2), NAND(B2, T6) )
XI1 b2 nb2 vss vdd inv
XA1 nb2 t2 b1a vss vdd nand2
XA2 b2 t6 b1b vss vdd nand2
XA3 b1a b1b b1 vss vdd nand2
* B0 = (NOT B2 AND MUX1) OR (B2 AND MUX2)
* MUX1 = (NOT B1 AND T1) OR (B1 AND T3) = NAND(NAND(NB1,T1),NAND(B1,T3))
* MUX2 = (NOT B1 AND T5) OR (B1 AND T7) = NAND(NAND(NB1,T5),NAND(B1,T7))
* B0   = NAND(NAND(NB2,MUX1), NAND(B2,MUX2))
XI2 b1 nb1 vss vdd inv
XM1 nb1 t1 m1a vss vdd nand2
XM2 b1 t3 m1b vss vdd nand2
XM3 m1a m1b mux1 vss vdd nand2
XM4 nb1 t5 m2a vss vdd nand2
XM5 b1 t7 m2b vss vdd nand2
XM6 m2a m2b mux2 vss vdd nand2
XB1 nb2 mux1 b0a vss vdd nand2
XB2 b2 mux2 b0b vss vdd nand2
XB3 b0a b0b b0 vss vdd nand2
.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V MOS plus ideal R/C.

* Signal path:

*   -> 7 StrongARM comparators clocked directly by clk (reset while clk low,
*      decide on the rising edge)
*   -> inverter-buffered NOR SR latches (hold decision through clk low)
*   -> static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder driving b2 b1 b0.
*
* Aperture alignment: a StrongARM's effective sampling instant trails the
* clock edge by an amount that grows as the input common mode falls (about
* 175 ps at the 1.3 V tap to 290 ps at the 0.7 V tap, fs/1.98 V/125 C). Each
* comparator's vin feed is delayed by a first-order RC of tau_i =

* 20-45 ps after the clock edge. The tap side gets an identical RC so that
* comparator kickback stays common-mode.

XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends fadc_inv

*   clk is low; static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder + output drivers

* =====================================================================
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC
*   vrefn = 0.6 V, vrefp = 1.4 V  ->  ideal LSB = 0.1 V
*   Sky130 1.8 V MOS devices + ideal R / C only.
*
* Architecture
*   - 8 x 2.5k ideal resistor ladder (taps t1..t7 at 0.7 .. 1.3 V),
*     each tap decoupled to vss with an ideal capacitor.
*   - 7 clocked dynamic comparators (classic StrongARM): precharged
*     while clk is low, evaluated on the rising edge, so the aperture
*     is the rising clock edge.  The input pair and the cross-coupled
*     NMOS pair share one tail node, so the tail self-regulates and
*     the input pair is live from the start of evaluation.
*   - Each comparator output is buffered by an inverter, so the hold
*     latch sees a symmetric gate load instead of the data-dependent
*     load of the latch itself.
*   - 7 cross-coupled NOR SR latches hold the thermometer decision
*     while clk is low (the comparator precharges, the latch holds).
*   - Static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder + output buffers.
* =====================================================================

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked dynamic comparator core (StrongARM).
*   x = drain of the vin-side input device.  x falls when vin > ref.
*   y = drain of the ref-side input device.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmp_core vss vdd clk vin ref x y
XNTAIL tail clk vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XNIN   x    vin tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XNREF  y    ref tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XNLAT1 y    x   tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XNLAT2 x    y   tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=0.42 nf=1
XPLAT1 x    y   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPLAT2 y    x   vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPREx  x    clk vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XPREy  y    clk vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends cmp_core

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* NOR SR latch:  q = NOR(s, qb),  qb = NOR(r, q)
* s = yb, r = xb (inverted comparator outputs) -> q = thermometer bit.
* Precharge (x = y = vdd) gives s = r = 0, so the latch holds.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt nor_sr vss vdd s r q qb
* q = NOR(s, qb): series PMOS pull-up, parallel NMOS pull-down
XPA p1 s  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XPB q  qb p1  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XNA q  s  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XNB q  qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
* qb = NOR(r, q)
XPC p2 r  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XPD qb q  p2  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XNC qb r  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XND qb q  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
.ends nor_sr

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Static CMOS gates
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XNA y a na  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
XNB na b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
.ends nand2

.subckt nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XPA y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XPB y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XPC y  c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XPD y  d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XNA y  a n1  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XNB n1 b n2  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XNC n2 c n3  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XND n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends nand4

.subckt inv1 vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
.ends inv2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top level
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* --- reference ladder: 8 equal ideal resistors, 0.1 V per tap ---
R0 vrefp t7 2.5k
R1 t7 t6 2.5k
R2 t6 t5 2.5k
R3 t5 t4 2.5k
R4 t4 t3 2.5k
R5 t3 t2 2.5k
R6 t2 t1 2.5k
R7 t1 vrefn 2.5k

C1 t1 vss 1p
C2 t2 vss 1p
C3 t3 vss 1p
C4 t4 vss 1p
C5 t5 vss 1p
C6 t6 vss 1p
C7 t7 vss 1p

* --- 7 clocked comparators ---
XC1 vss vdd clk vin t1 x1 y1 cmp_core
XC2 vss vdd clk vin t2 x2 y2 cmp_core
XC3 vss vdd clk vin t3 x3 y3 cmp_core
XC4 vss vdd clk vin t4 x4 y4 cmp_core
XC5 vss vdd clk vin t5 x5 y5 cmp_core
XC6 vss vdd clk vin t6 x6 y6 cmp_core
XC7 vss vdd clk vin t7 x7 y7 cmp_core

* --- output buffers (symmetric load on the comparator nodes) ---
XIX1 vss vdd x1 xb1 inv1
XIY1 vss vdd y1 yb1 inv1
XIX2 vss vdd x2 xb2 inv1
XIY2 vss vdd y2 yb2 inv1
XIX3 vss vdd x3 xb3 inv1
XIY3 vss vdd y3 yb3 inv1
XIX4 vss vdd x4 xb4 inv1
XIY4 vss vdd y4 yb4 inv1
XIX5 vss vdd x5 xb5 inv1
XIY5 vss vdd y5 yb5 inv1
XIX6 vss vdd x6 xb6 inv1
XIY6 vss vdd y6 yb6 inv1
XIX7 vss vdd x7 xb7 inv1
XIY7 vss vdd y7 yb7 inv1

* --- 7 decision hold latches (q = thermometer bit) ---
XL1 vss vdd yb1 xb1 q1 qb1 nor_sr
XL2 vss vdd yb2 xb2 q2 qb2 nor_sr
XL3 vss vdd yb3 xb3 q3 qb3 nor_sr
XL4 vss vdd yb4 xb4 q4 qb4 nor_sr
XL5 vss vdd yb5 xb5 q5 qb5 nor_sr
XL6 vss vdd yb6 xb6 q6 qb6 nor_sr
XL7 vss vdd yb7 xb7 q7 qb7 nor_sr

* --- thermometer to binary ---
*   b2 = t4
*   b1 = t6 + t2*!t4
*   b0 = t1*!t2 + t3*!t4 + t5*!t6 + t7
XB2A vss vdd q4 e2a inv1
XB2B vss vdd e2a b2 inv2

XE1  vss vdd q2 qb4 e1 nand2
XB1A vss vdd qb6 e1 e1b nand2
XB1B vss vdd e1b e1c inv1
XB1C vss vdd e1c b1 inv2

XF1 vss vdd q1 qb2 f1 nand2
XF2 vss vdd q3 qb4 f2 nand2
XF3 vss vdd q5 qb6 f3 nand2
XF4 vss vdd f1 f2 f3 qb7 f4 nand4
XB0A vss vdd f4 e0a inv1
XB0B vss vdd e0a b0 inv2

.ends flash_adc_3bit

XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends adc_drv

* -------------------------------------------------------------- 2-in NOR
.subckt adc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XPA m a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPB y b m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends adc_nor2

* ------------------------------------------- AOI22: y = !(a*b + c*d)
.subckt adc_aoi22 vss vdd a b c d y
XNA y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNB n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XNC y c n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XND n2 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=1
XPA p1 a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPB p1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPC y c p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
XPD y d p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=1
.ends adc_aoi22

* ------------------------------------------------ clocked comparator slice
* StrongARM latch: reset (all internal nodes to vdd) while clk is low,
* regenerate while clk is high.  p falls when inp > inn, q falls otherwise.
* Low-Vt tail and input pair driven straight from clk keep the effective
* sampling instant within ~0.14-0.22 ns of the clock edge at all corners;
* full x/y reset removes input-history memory.
* Buffered decision drives a NOR SR latch that holds t/tb through reset.
.subckt adc_cmp vss vdd clk inp inn t tb
XMT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XM1 x inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XM2 y inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XM3 p q x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM4 q p y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM5 p q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XM6 q p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XR1 p clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XR2 q clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XR3 x clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XR4 y clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* low-threshold decision buffers (identical loads on p and q)
XSN s p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XSP s p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XRN r q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XRP r q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
* hold latch: s=1 -> t=1, r=1 -> t=0, s=r=0 -> hold
XL1 vss vdd r tb t adc_nor2
XL2 vss vdd s t tb adc_nor2
.ends adc_cmp

* ------------------------------------------------------------------- top
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* reference ladder, taps at vrefn + k*(vrefp-vrefn)/8
RL0 vrefn r1 1k
RL1 r1 r2 1k
RL2 r2 r3 1k
RL3 r3 r4 1k
RL4 r4 r5 1k
RL5 r5 r6 1k
RL6 r6 r7 1k
RL7 r7 vrefp 1k
CR1 r1 vss 2p
CR2 r2 vss 2p
CR3 r3 vss 2p
CR4 r4 vss 2p
CR5 r5 vss 2p
CR6 r6 vss 2p
CR7 r7 vss 2p
* comparators: t_k = (vin > r_k)
XC1 vss vdd clk vin r1 t1 tb1 adc_cmp
XC2 vss vdd clk vin r2 t2 tb2 adc_cmp
XC3 vss vdd clk vin r3 t3 tb3 adc_cmp
XC4 vss vdd clk vin r4 t4 tb4 adc_cmp
XC5 vss vdd clk vin r5 t5 tb5 adc_cmp
XC6 vss vdd clk vin r6 t6 tb6 adc_cmp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin r7 t7 tb7 adc_cmp
* mux-tree encoder: b2=t4, b1=t4?t6:t2, b0=t4?(t6?t7:t5):(t2?t3:t1)
XE1 vss vdd t4 t6 tb4 t2 b1n adc_aoi22
XE2 vss vdd t6 t7 tb6 t5 mhin adc_aoi22
XE3 vss vdd t2 t3 tb2 t1 mlon adc_aoi22
XE4 vss vdd mhin mhi adc_inv
XE5 vss vdd mlon mlo adc_inv
XE6 vss vdd t4 mhi tb4 mlo b0n adc_aoi22
* output drivers
XO2 vss vdd tb4 b2 adc_drv
XO1 vss vdd b1n b1 adc_drv
XO0 vss vdd b0n b0 adc_drv
.ends flash_adc_3bit
