circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC for 0.6 V .. 1.4 V reference span (Sky130 1.8 V MOS).
* Architecture: 8R resistor ladder -> 7 StrongARM-latch comparators (sampling on
* the rising clock edge) -> NAND SR hold latches -> CMOS thermometer-to-binary
* encoder.  All logic is static CMOS so the decision is held through the clk-low
* phase, where the 19 ns post-edge sample is taken.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Digital standard cells
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends inv

.subckt buf a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
.ends buf

.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
XMN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 a b y vss vdd
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends nor2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* StrongARM-latch comparator + NAND SR hold latch.
* q = 1 when vin > vref, sampled on the rising edge of clk and held through
* the clk-low phase.  During clk-low the StrongARM resets (op=on=vdd) and the
* NAND SR latch retains the decision.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmp vin vref clk vss vdd q
XMP1 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMP2 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMN1 op vin cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN2 on vref cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMT cs clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMPC1 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMPC2 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XNAND1 op qb q vss vdd nand2
XNAND2 on q qb vss vdd nand2
.ends cmp

* Low-threshold comparator variant: c1 (tap = 0.7 V) resolves at the lowest
* input common-mode, where the regular input pair is weakest, so it gets a
* wider input pair (more gm) to speed resolution and reduce input offset.
.subckt cmp1 vin vref clk vss vdd q
XMP1 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMP2 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=2
XMN1 op vin cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN2 on vref cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMT cs clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMPC1 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMPC2 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XNAND1 op qb q vss vdd nand2
XNAND2 on q qb vss vdd nand2
.ends cmp1

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Thermometer-to-binary encoder (active-high in/out).
*   b2 = c4
*   b1 = (c2 & ~c4) | c6
*   b0 = (c1 & ~c2) | (c3 & ~c4) | (c5 & ~c6) | c7
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt enc c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 vss vdd b2 b1 b0
Xinv_c2 c2 c2b vss vdd inv
Xinv_c4 c4 c4b vss vdd inv
Xinv_c6 c6 c6b vss vdd inv
Xinv_c7 c7 c7b vss vdd inv
* b2 = c4 (buffered, non-inverting)
Xb2i c4 b2p vss vdd inv
Xb2a b2p b2 vss vdd buf
* b1 = NAND(NAND(c2,c4b), c6b)
Xn1 c2 c4b m vss vdd nand2
Xn2 m c6b b1p vss vdd nand2
Xb1a b1p b1m vss vdd inv
Xb1b b1m b1 vss vdd buf
* b0
Xm1 c1 c2b m1 vss vdd nand2
Xm2 c3 c4b m2 vss vdd nand2
Xm3 c5 c6b m3 vss vdd nand2
Xa1 m1 m2 a1 vss vdd nand2
Xa2 m3 c7b a2 vss vdd nand2
Xx a1 a2 x vss vdd nor2
Xb0i x b0p vss vdd inv
Xb0a b0p b0m vss vdd inv
Xb0b b0m b0 vss vdd buf
.ends enc

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level flash ADC
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Resistor ladder: vrefp -> t7(1.3) -> t6(1.2) -> ... -> t1(0.7) -> vrefn
R1 vrefp t7 5k
R2 t7 t6 5k
R3 t6 t5 5k
R4 t5 t4 5k
R5 t4 t3 5k
R6 t3 t2 5k
R7 t2 t1 5k
R8 t1 vrefn 5k
* Decouple the ladder taps from comparator kickback (stiffen the tap nodes).
C1 t1 vss 100f
C2 t2 vss 100f
C3 t3 vss 100f
C4 t4 vss 100f
C5 t5 vss 100f
C6 t6 vss 100f
C7 t7 vss 100f
* Seven comparators: c_i = (vin > t_i).  c1 uses the wider-input variant.
XC1 vin t1 clk vss vdd c1 cmp1
XC2 vin t2 clk vss vdd c2 cmp
XC3 vin t3 clk vss vdd c3 cmp
XC4 vin t4 clk vss vdd c4 cmp
XC5 vin t5 clk vss vdd c5 cmp
XC6 vin t6 clk vss vdd c6 cmp
XC7 vin t7 clk vss vdd c7 cmp
* Encoder
XENC c1 c2 c3 c4 c5 c6 c7 vss vdd b2 b1 b0 enc
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC for Sky130 1.8 V MOS.
* vrefn=0.6 V, vrefp=1.4 V -> 0.1 V LSB.  b2 = MSB.
* Architecture: resistor ladder, seven double-tail latch comparators
* (input integrator + delayed isolated latch), NOR SR hold latches, and
* a CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Basic CMOS gates (local helper subcircuits)
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt invh vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends invh

.subckt buf vss vdd a y
XI1 vss vdd a m inv
XI2 vss vdd m y invh
.ends buf

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1 y a n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 n b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XMP1 n a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMP2 y b n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand3 vss vdd a b c y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN2 m1 b m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN3 m2 c vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends nand3

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked comparator: double-tail latch + NOR SR hold latch.
* q = 1 when vinp > vinn; decision made on rising clk, held through
* the following clk-low reset phase.  The input pair integrates on clk
* while the cross-coupled latch regenerates on a delayed clock (clkd),
* so the latch cannot collapse the internal nodes before the input
* differential is established (fixes the low- and high-common-mode
* threshold errors of a plain StrongARM).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt cmp vss vdd clk vinp vinn q
* Delayed clock for the latch tail (non-inverting, ~2 inverter delays).
XI1 vss vdd clk ckb inv
XI2 vss vdd ckb clkd inv
* Precharge (reset phase, clk low).
XMP1 pn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP2 nn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* PMOS cross-coupled pull-up latch.
XMP3 pn nn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMP4 nn pn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* Input pair (integration) and its tail.  A tail resistor limits the
* input-pair current at high common mode so the integrator nodes cannot
* collapse below the latch threshold before clkd fires.
XMN1 pn vinp cs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN2 nn vinn cs1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
RMT1 cs1 cs1t 20k
XMT1 cs1t clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* NMOS cross-coupled latch and its delayed tail.
XMN3 pn nn cs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMN4 nn pn cs2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XMT2 cs2 clkd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Isolating buffers so the hold latch cannot load the latch nodes asymmetrically.
XB1 vss vdd pn pnb inv
XB2 vss vdd nn nnb inv
* NOR SR hold latch: S=pnb (set high when vinp>vinn), R=nnb.
XN_S vss vdd pnb q qb nor2
XN_R vss vdd nnb qb q nor2
.ends cmp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level 3-bit flash ADC.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Resistor ladder: 8 equal segments, taps at 0.7 ... 1.3 V.
R1 vrefn tap1 1k
R2 tap1 tap2 1k
R3 tap2 tap3 1k
R4 tap3 tap4 1k
R5 tap4 tap5 1k
R6 tap5 tap6 1k
R7 tap6 tap7 1k
R8 tap7 vrefp 1k
* Reference decoupling (kickback reservoir).
C1 tap1 vss 100f
C2 tap2 vss 100f
C3 tap3 vss 100f
C4 tap4 vss 100f
C5 tap5 vss 100f
C6 tap6 vss 100f
C7 tap7 vss 100f
* Seven comparators: thermometer bit th_i = 1 when vin > tap_i.
XC1 vss vdd clk vin tap1 th1 cmp
XC2 vss vdd clk vin tap2 th2 cmp
XC3 vss vdd clk vin tap3 th3 cmp
XC4 vss vdd clk vin tap4 th4 cmp
XC5 vss vdd clk vin tap5 th5 cmp
XC6 vss vdd clk vin tap6 th6 cmp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin tap7 th7 cmp
* Thermometer-to-binary encoder.
*   b2 = th4
*   b1 = th2*!th4 + th6
*   b0 = th1*!th2 + th3*!th4 + th5*!th6 + th7
XI2 vss vdd th2 nb2 inv
XI4 vss vdd th4 nb4 inv
XI6 vss vdd th6 nb6 inv
* b2
XB2 vss vdd th4 b2 buf
* b1 = NAND( NAND(th2,nb4), NAND(th6,th6) )
XN1A vss vdd th2 nb4 b1_x1 nand2
XN1B vss vdd th6 th6 b1_x2 nand2
XN1C vss vdd b1_x1 b1_x2 b1_n nand2
XB1 vss vdd b1_n b1 buf
* b0 = a + b + c + th7,  a=th1*!th2, b=th3*!th4, c=th5*!th6
XN0A vss vdd th1 nb2 b0_a nand2
XN0B vss vdd th3 nb4 b0_b nand2
XN0C vss vdd th5 nb6 b0_c nand2
XN0M vss vdd b0_a b0_b b0_c b0_m nand3
XN0M1 vss vdd b0_m b0_m b0_mm nand2
XN0T vss vdd th7 th7 b0_t7 nand2
XN0F vss vdd b0_mm b0_t7 b0_n nand2
XB0 vss vdd b0_n b0 buf
.ends flash_adc_3bit

* ===================================================================
* flash_adc_3bit -- 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, 0.6 V .. 1.4 V span
* -------------------------------------------------------------------
* Architecture
*   vrefp/vrefn -> ideal resistor ladder (8 segments, 7 taps, 0.1 V LSB)
*   7 clocked StrongARM comparators (sample on the rising clock edge)
*   NAND set/reset latch per comparator (holds the decision while the
*   clock is low)
*   thermometer-to-binary encoder (AND-OR form, both polarities taken
*   from the latch outputs)
*   two-inverter output buffers driving b2/b1/b0
*   b2 = w4
*   b1 = w2&~w4 | w6
*   b0 = w1&~w2 | w3&~w4 | w5&~w6 | w7
* ===================================================================

* ---------------- logic gates (parameter free) ---------------------
.subckt adc_inv_a a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends adc_inv_a

.subckt adc_inv_b a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.25 nf=1
.ends adc_inv_b

.subckt adc_inv_c a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends adc_inv_c

.subckt adc_inv_d a y vss vdd
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=4
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
.ends adc_inv_d

.subckt adc_nand2 a b y vss vdd
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNA mna a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMNB y b mna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

.subckt adc_nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMPC y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMPD y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMNA m1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMNB m2 b m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMNC m3 c m2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMND y d m3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends adc_nand4

* ---------------- StrongARM clocked comparator ---------------------
* inp  : signal input (vin)
* inn  : reference input (ladder tap)
* ckc  : internal clock, high = evaluate, low = reset/precharge
* outp : falls when inp > inn
* outn : falls when inn > inp
.subckt adc_sacmp inp inn ckc outp outn vss vdd
XMRP outp ckc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XMRN outn ckc vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XMP1 outp outn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMP2 outn outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XMN1 outp outn na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMN2 outn outp nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMI1 na inp xt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMI2 nb inn xt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
XMT xt ckc vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
.ends adc_sacmp

* ---------------- NAND set/reset latch -----------------------------
* sn low -> q high ; rn low -> q low ; both high -> hold
.subckt adc_srl sn rn q qb vss vdd
XG1 sn qb q vss vdd adc_nand2
XG2 rn q qb vss vdd adc_nand2
.ends adc_srl

* ===================================================================
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* ---- clock conditioning: sharp, in phase with the external clk -----
XCKA clk cka vss vdd adc_inv_b
XCKB cka ckc vss vdd adc_inv_d

* ---- reference ladder: taps r1..r7 = 0.7 .. 1.3 V ------------------
RL1 vrefn r1 1k
RL2 r1 r2 1k
RL3 r2 r3 1k
RL4 r3 r4 1k
RL5 r4 r5 1k
RL6 r5 r6 1k
RL7 r6 r7 1k
RL8 r7 vrefp 1k
* tap stiffening capacitors: keep comparator kickback off the ladder
CR1 r1 vss 500f
CR2 r2 vss 500f
CR3 r3 vss 500f
CR4 r4 vss 500f
CR5 r5 vss 500f
CR6 r6 vss 500f
CR7 r7 vss 500f

* ---- comparator bank ----------------------------------------------
XS1 vin r1 ckc p1 n1 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS2 vin r2 ckc p2 n2 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS3 vin r3 ckc p3 n3 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS4 vin r4 ckc p4 n4 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS5 vin r5 ckc p5 n5 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS6 vin r6 ckc p6 n6 vss vdd adc_sacmp
XS7 vin r7 ckc p7 n7 vss vdd adc_sacmp

* ---- decision storage ---------------------------------------------
XL1 p1 n1 w1 w1b vss vdd adc_srl
XL2 p2 n2 w2 w2b vss vdd adc_srl
XL3 p3 n3 w3 w3b vss vdd adc_srl
XL4 p4 n4 w4 w4b vss vdd adc_srl
XL5 p5 n5 w5 w5b vss vdd adc_srl
XL6 p6 n6 w6 w6b vss vdd adc_srl
XL7 p7 n7 w7 w7b vss vdd adc_srl

* ---- thermometer to binary ----------------------------------------
* b2 = w4
XB2A w4 b2x vss vdd adc_inv_b
XB2B b2x b2 vss vdd adc_inv_c

* b1 = (w2 & ~w4) | w6
XE1 w2 w4b e1 vss vdd adc_nand2
XE2 e1 w6b b1i vss vdd adc_nand2
XB1A b1i b1x vss vdd adc_inv_b
XB1B b1x b1 vss vdd adc_inv_c

* b0 = (w1&~w2) | (w3&~w4) | (w5&~w6) | w7
XF1 w1 w2b f1 vss vdd adc_nand2
XF3 w3 w4b f3 vss vdd adc_nand2
XF5 w5 w6b f5 vss vdd adc_nand2
XF0 f1 f3 f5 w7b b0i vss vdd adc_nand4
XB0A b0i b0x vss vdd adc_inv_b
XB0B b0x b0 vss vdd adc_inv_c

.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* ============================================================================
*  flash_adc_3bit  --  3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC  (sky130 1.8 V CMOS)
*
*  .subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
*
*  Architecture
*    - 8-tap ideal resistor ladder vrefn..vrefp -> thresholds 0.7 .. 1.3 V
*    - 7 strongARM comparators.  The regenerative cross-coupled pair has its
*      own tail switch so its current never loads the input-pair source node;
*      the input pair sits behind a switched ideal resistor that both bounds
*      the post-decision current and self-biases the source node between
*      conversion edges (no race at the start of evaluation).
*    - NAND SR decision-hold latch per comparator (outputs q = T_j, qb)
*    - static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder, buffered outputs
* ============================================================================

* ---------------- digital cells ----------------
.subckt fa_inv a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends fa_inv

.subckt fa_invb a y vdd vss
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
.ends fa_invb

.subckt fa_nand2 a b y vdd vss
XMN1 na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN2 y  b na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMP1 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP2 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends fa_nand2

.subckt fa_nand4 a b c d y vdd vss
XMN1 na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMN2 nb b na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMN3 nc c nb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMN4 y  d nc vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XMP1 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP2 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP3 y  c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP4 y  d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends fa_nand4

* NAND2 whose b input trips late (weak b NMOS, strong b PMOS).  With b tied to
* the comparator strobe its output only drops once the strobe is well up.
.subckt fa_nand2i a b y vdd vss
XMN1 na a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XMN2 y  b na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMP1 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP2 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
.ends fa_nand2i

* ---------------- comparator + decision hold ----------------
* strongARM core.  clk high = evaluation, clk low = reset/precharge.
* `strb` is a delayed copy of clk that enables the regenerative pair, so the
* input pair (whose source node has to re-position after a large vin step)
* is already settled and dominating the d-node discharge when the latch
* commits.  `nis` (NAND(clk, strb-delay)) additionally disconnects the input
* pair from the regenerative nodes once the strobe has risen: the input is
* integrated onto d1/d2 only during the first part of the evaluation phase,
* after which a still-slewing vin cannot disturb the stored decision.
* d1 falls <=> vin > vref <=> t (== T_j) goes high.
.subckt fa_cmp vin vref clk strb nis vdd vss t tb
* precharge of the latch nodes
XMP1  d1 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XMP2  d2 clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
* regenerative cross-coupled pair, own strobed tail switch
XXP1  d1 d2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XXP2  d2 d1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XXN1  d1 d2  sl  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XXN2  d2 d1  sl  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6 nf=1
XNSW  sl strb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
* input pair, integrated onto the latch nodes through the nis switches
XIS1  d1  nis d1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XIS2  d2  nis d2x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XIN1  d1x vin  si vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XIN2  d2x vref si vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
RITL  si sn 10k
XISW  sn clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
* NAND SR latch: t = NAND(d1,tb) , tb = NAND(d2,t)
XSL1  d1 tb t  vdd vss fa_nand2
XSL2  d2 t  tb vdd vss fa_nand2
.ends fa_cmp

* ============================================================================
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* ---- reference ladder: 8 equal ideal resistors, taps 0.7 .. 1.3 V ----
RL1 vrefn rt1 1k
RL2 rt1 rt2 1k
RL3 rt2 rt3 1k
RL4 rt3 rt4 1k
RL5 rt4 rt5 1k
RL6 rt5 rt6 1k
RL7 rt6 rt7 1k
RL8 rt7 vrefp 1k
CT1 rt1 vss 800f
CT2 rt2 vss 800f
CT3 rt3 vss 800f
CT4 rt4 vss 800f
CT5 rt5 vss 800f
CT6 rt6 vss 800f
CT7 rt7 vss 800f

* ---- comparator strobe: clk delayed on the rising edge ----
* R/C makes `cd` lag clk; the pass PMOS gives a fast falling edge so the
* regenerative tail switch closes as soon as clk goes low again.
RDP clk cd 5k
CDP cd vss 100f
XFD cd clk clk vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1

* ---- input-integration window: nis = NAND(clk, cd) ----
* high (input pair connected to the latch nodes) while clk is low and while
* cd is still low after the rising edge; drops once the strobe is well up,
* isolating the regenerative nodes from vin for the rest of the phase.
XNI clk cd nis vdd vss fa_nand2i

* ---- comparator bank ----
XC1 vin rt1 clk cd nis vdd vss q1  qb1  fa_cmp
XC2 vin rt2 clk cd nis vdd vss q2  qb2  fa_cmp
XC3 vin rt3 clk cd nis vdd vss q3  qb3  fa_cmp
XC4 vin rt4 clk cd nis vdd vss q4  qb4  fa_cmp
XC5 vin rt5 clk cd nis vdd vss q5  qb5  fa_cmp
XC6 vin rt6 clk cd nis vdd vss q6  qb6  fa_cmp
XC7 vin rt7 clk cd nis vdd vss q7  qb7  fa_cmp

* ---- thermometer-to-binary encoder ----
*  b2 = T4
*  b1 = T2&!T4 | T6
*  b0 = T1&!T2 | T3&!T4 | T5&!T6 | T7
XNA1 q1 qb2 na1 vdd vss fa_nand2
XNA3 q3 qb4 na3 vdd vss fa_nand2
XNA5 q5 qb6 na5 vdd vss fa_nand2
XNA2 q2 qb4 na2 vdd vss fa_nand2
XB0 na1 na3 na5 qb7 b0n vdd vss fa_nand4
XB1 na2 qb6 b1n vdd vss fa_nand2

* ---- output buffers ----
XB2A q4   b2a vdd vss fa_inv
XB2B b2a  b2  vdd vss fa_invb
XB1A b1n  b1a vdd vss fa_inv
XB1B b1a  b1  vdd vss fa_invb
XB0A b0n  b0a vdd vss fa_inv
XB0B b0a  b0  vdd vss fa_invb

.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit, rising-edge sampled flash ADC.
* All dimensions are in micrometres (the SKY130 wrapper scale is 1u).

.subckt adc_inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt adc_inv_lg vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
.ends adc_inv_lg

* High-trip inverter used only by the rising-edge delay ramp.
.subckt adc_inv_delay vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
.ends adc_inv_delay

* Low-trip, strong-falling clock inverter for the sampling switch.
.subckt adc_inv_sample vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=64.0 nf=32
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=4
.ends adc_inv_sample

* Matched track/hold cell.  Sampling both sides of every decision cancels
* the deterministic switch charge step at the comparator boundary.
.subckt adc_sampler vss vdd a clk clkb q
XN q clkb a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32.0 nf=16
XP q clk  a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=32.0 nf=16
CH q vss 500f
.ends adc_sampler

* Fully symmetric low-power differential preamplifier.  The two diode-
* connected loads make its zero differential point independent of the
* inverter trip point used after the cascaded gain stages.
.subckt adc_dif vss vdd vb ip im op om
XNP op ip ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XNM om im ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XNT ns vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4
XPP op op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.84 nf=2
XPM om om vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends adc_dif

* Differential-to-single-ended high-gain stage with a PMOS mirror load.
.subckt adc_se vss vdd vb ip im y
XNL nl  ip ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XNR y   im ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=3
XNT ns  vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.50 w=1.68 nf=4
XPL nl  nl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.84 nf=2
XPR y   nl vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.30 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends adc_se

* Static comparator: hi is asserted for vin > vr; lo is its complement.
.subckt adc_cmp vss vdd vb vin vr hi lo
X1 vss vdd vb vin vr a1p a1m adc_dif
X2 vss vdd vb a1p a1m a2p a2m adc_dif
X3 vss vdd vb a2p a2m a3p a3m adc_dif
* Three differential inversions leave a3p low when vin is high.  Compare
* the pair directly so the decision does not depend on their common mode.
XS vss vdd vb a3m a3p so adc_se
XIB vss vdd so hib adc_inv
XIH vss vdd hib hi adc_inv
XIL vss vdd hi lo adc_inv
.ends adc_cmp

* Complementary transmission-gate 2:1 mux.  s=0 selects d0.
.subckt adc_mux vss vdd d0 d1 s sb y
XN0 y sb d0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP0 y s  d0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XN1 y s  d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XP1 y sb d1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
.ends adc_mux

* Static transmission-gate latch, transparent when en=1.
.subckt adc_latch vss vdd d en enb q
XNI nx en  d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPI nx enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNF nx enb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPF nx en  q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XI1 vss vdd nx ni adc_inv
XI2 vss vdd ni q adc_inv
.ends adc_latch

* Rising-edge master/slave storage.  The last inverter is sized for 15 fF.
.subckt adc_dff vss vdd d clk clkb q
XM vss vdd d  clkb clk qm adc_latch
XS vss vdd qm clk clkb qi adc_latch
XOB vss vdd qi qn adc_inv
XO  vss vdd qn q adc_inv_lg
.ends adc_dff

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Eight equal ideal sections establish exact 0.7 ... 1.3 V references.
RL7 vrefp r7 200
RL6 r7 r6 200
RL5 r6 r5 200
RL4 r5 r4 200
RL3 r4 r3 200
RL2 r3 r2 200
RL1 r2 r1 200
RL0 r1 vrefn 200

* Track during clock-low and hold the conversion-edge voltages during clock-
* high.  The disclosed zero-ohm input source settles the input cell directly.
XCK vss vdd clk clkb adc_inv_sample
XSV1 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv1 adc_sampler
XSV2 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv2 adc_sampler
XSV3 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv3 adc_sampler
XSV4 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv4 adc_sampler
XSV5 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv5 adc_sampler
XSV6 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv6 adc_sampler
XSV7 vss vdd vin clk clkb sv7 adc_sampler
XSR1 vss vdd r1  clk clkb sr1 adc_sampler
XSR2 vss vdd r2  clk clkb sr2 adc_sampler
XSR3 vss vdd r3  clk clkb sr3 adc_sampler
XSR4 vss vdd r4  clk clkb sr4 adc_sampler
XSR5 vss vdd r5  clk clkb sr5 adc_sampler
XSR6 vss vdd r6  clk clkb sr6 adc_sampler
XSR7 vss vdd r7  clk clkb sr7 adc_sampler

* Seven continuously tracking comparators form the thermometer word.
XC1 vss vdd r1 sv1 sr1 t1 n1 adc_cmp
XC2 vss vdd r1 sv2 sr2 t2 n2 adc_cmp
XC3 vss vdd r1 sv3 sr3 t3 n3 adc_cmp
XC4 vss vdd r1 sv4 sr4 t4 n4 adc_cmp
XC5 vss vdd r1 sv5 sr5 t5 n5 adc_cmp
XC6 vss vdd r1 sv6 sr6 t6 n6 adc_cmp
XC7 vss vdd r1 sv7 sr7 t7 n7 adc_cmp

* Thermometer-to-binary encoder.  Thermometer monotonicity permits a short
* mux tree rather than a long XOR chain.
* bit 2 = T4
XI2A vss vdd t4 d2n adc_inv
XI2B vss vdd d2n d2 adc_inv
* bit 1 = T2 below T4, and T6 above T4
XM1 vss vdd t2 t6 t4 n4 m1 adc_mux
XI1A vss vdd m1 d1n adc_inv
XI1B vss vdd d1n d1 adc_inv
* bit 0 selects T1/T3/T5/T7 according to the two upper bits.
XM0L vss vdd t1 t3 d1 d1n m0l adc_mux
XM0H vss vdd t5 t7 d1 d1n m0h adc_mux
XM0F vss vdd m0l m0h d2 d2n m0 adc_mux
XI0A vss vdd m0 d0n adc_inv
XI0B vss vdd d0n d0 adc_inv

* An ideal-RC delay gives the held comparators time to resolve, while keeping
* the registered output crossing comfortably ahead of the 9.5 ns deadline.
RCD clk cdel 100k
CCD cdel vss 50f
XDRST cdel clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XDCB vss vdd cdel clkdb adc_inv_delay
XDC  vss vdd clkdb clkd adc_inv_lg
XD2 vss vdd d2 clkd clkdb b2 adc_dff
XD1 vss vdd d1 clkd clkdb b1 adc_dff
XD0 vss vdd d0 clkd clkdb b0 adc_dff
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit flash ADC: resistor-ladder references, seven preamplifier + clocked
* regenerative-latch comparators, SR decision latches, and a CMOS
* thermometer-to-binary encoder.
*
* Pin order: vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0  (b2 = MSB)
* Ideal 0.1 V LSB: thresholds at 0.70 .. 1.30 V in 0.1 V steps.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Standard CMOS gates (parameter-free helpers).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt INV1 vss vdd a y
XN0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends INV1

.subckt INV2 vss vdd a y
XN0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends INV2

.subckt NAND2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y a n0 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 n0 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP0 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP1 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends NAND2

.subckt NOR2 vss vdd a b y
XN0 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP0 y a p0 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP1 p0 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends NOR2

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Shared bias generator: diode-connected NMOS + resistor -> vb.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt BIAS vss vdd vb
RB0 vdd vb 40k
XM0 vb vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends BIAS

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked regenerative latch (StrongARM core) + SR hold latch.
* lp = positive input, ln = negative input; tout = 1 when lp > ln.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt LATCH vss vdd clk lp ln tout
XMT tl clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XM1 op lp tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XM2 on ln tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN1 op on tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMN2 on op tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XMC1 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMC2 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP1 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP2 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* SR NAND latch (active-low S=op, R=on): Q = tout.
XNANDA vss vdd op qb tout NAND2
XNANDB vss vdd on tout qb NAND2
.ends LATCH

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Comparator = resistive-load differential preamplifier + latch.
* tout = 1 when vinp > vref, held while clk is low.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt CMP vss vdd vb clk vinp vref tout
* Preamp: NMOS differential pair, resistive loads to vdd.
XMT pa_tl vb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XM1 pa_p vinp pa_tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XM2 pa_n vref pa_tl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
RP1 vdd pa_p 40k
RP2 vdd pa_n 40k
* Absorb latch kickback so it does not perturb the preamp outputs.
CKB_P pa_p vss 50f
CKB_N pa_n vss 50f
* Latch samples pa_n (higher when vinp > vref) against pa_p.
XLATCH vss vdd clk pa_n pa_p tout LATCH
.ends CMP

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level flash ADC.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Resistor ladder: vrefp(1.4) -> r1(1.3) -> r2(1.2) -> r3(1.1) -> r4(1.0)
*                  -> r5(0.9) -> r6(0.8) -> r7(0.7) -> vrefn(0.6)
RL0 vrefp r1 40k
RL1 r1 r2 40k
RL2 r2 r3 40k
RL3 r3 r4 40k
RL4 r4 r5 40k
RL5 r5 r6 40k
RL6 r6 r7 40k
RL7 r7 vrefn 40k
* Bypass caps to absorb comparator kickback on the ladder taps.
CB1 r1 vss 0.5p
CB2 r2 vss 0.5p
CB3 r3 vss 0.5p
CB4 r4 vss 0.5p
CB5 r5 vss 0.5p
CB6 r6 vss 0.5p
CB7 r7 vss 0.5p

XBIAS vss vdd vb BIAS

* Seven comparators: t_i = 1 when vin > threshold_i.
XC1 vss vdd vb clk vin r7 t1 CMP
XC2 vss vdd vb clk vin r6 t2 CMP
XC3 vss vdd vb clk vin r5 t3 CMP
XC4 vss vdd vb clk vin r4 t4 CMP
XC5 vss vdd vb clk vin r3 t5 CMP
XC6 vss vdd vb clk vin r2 t6 CMP
XC7 vss vdd vb clk vin r1 t7 CMP

* Thermometer-to-binary encoder.
*   b2 = t4
*   b1 = t6 | (t2 & ~t4)
*   b0 = (t1 & ~t2) | (t3 & ~t4) | (t5 & ~t6) | t7
XINV2 vss vdd t2 n2 INV1
XINV4 vss vdd t4 n4 INV1
XINV6 vss vdd t6 n6 INV1

* b1 = t6 | (t2 & ~t4)
XNAND_B1 vss vdd t2 n4 b1a NAND2
XINV_B1A vss vdd b1a b1ab INV1
XNOR_B1 vss vdd b1ab t6 b1n NOR2
XINV_B1 vss vdd b1n b1 INV2

* b0
XNAND_G12 vss vdd t1 n2 g12n NAND2
XINV_G12 vss vdd g12n g12 INV1
XNAND_G34 vss vdd t3 n4 g34n NAND2
XINV_G34 vss vdd g34n g34 INV1
XNAND_G56 vss vdd t5 n6 g56n NAND2
XINV_G56 vss vdd g56n g56 INV1
XNOR_O1 vss vdd g12 g34 o1n NOR2
XINV_O1 vss vdd o1n o1 INV1
XNOR_O2 vss vdd g56 t7 o2n NOR2
XINV_O2 vss vdd o2n o2 INV1
XNOR_O3 vss vdd o1 o2 b0n NOR2
XINV_B0 vss vdd b0n b0 INV2

* b2 = t4
XINV_B2A vss vdd t4 b2n INV1
XINV_B2 vss vdd b2n b2 INV2
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* ==================================================================
* flash_adc_3bit : 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC
* Interface: vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0   (b2 = MSB)
* Reference span vrefn..vrefp (0.6..1.4 V), 0.1 V nominal LSB.
*
* Architecture:
*   - ideal resistor ladder, 8 segments, taps r1..r7 = 0.7 .. 1.3 V
*   - 7 comparator slices:
*       continuous-time NMOS preamp (resistor tail + resistor loads)
*       clocked latched sense amplifier (strongARM with an added
*         cross-coupled PMOS pair, so ma/mb HOLD the decision for
*         the whole evaluation phase instead of collapsing)
*       NAND set/reset hold latch (level-sensitive, glitch free)
*   - static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder
* Note: every MOS uses nf=1; multi-finger geometries hit broken
* model bins (negative u0/Vsat) in the sky130 continuous library.
* ==================================================================

* ---- static CMOS gate library (all nf=1) --------------------------
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.1 nf=1
.ends inv
.subckt invd a y vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends invd
.subckt nand2 a b y vss vdd
XMN1 n1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
XMN2 y b n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.55 nf=1
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.1 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.1 nf=1
.ends nand2
.subckt nand2d a b y vss vdd
XMN1 n1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN2 y b n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
.ends nand2d
.subckt nand4 a b c d y vss vdd
XMN1 n1 a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN2 n2 b n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN3 n3 c n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMN4 y d n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand4

* ---- comparator slice --------------------------------------------
* clk  : conversion clock (rising edge = sampling edge)
* clkb : internal inverted clock
* vin  : signal input, vtap : ladder tap, t : thermometer output
* t = 1 when vin > vtap at the clock edge; level is held until the
* next edge (NAND latch keeps it through the reset phase).
.subckt cmpslice clk clkb vin vtap t vss vdd
* continuous-time preamplifier; isolates ladder from clock kickback
XM1 oa vin ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
XM2 ob vtap ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
RT ns vss 30k
RLA vdd oa 30k
RLB vdd ob 30k
* latched sense amplifier.  Long-channel input pair keeps the tail
* node low: the strong-gate side always becomes the loser, so the
* only static path is the weak-gate device into the tail (a few uA).
* Cross-coupled PMOS (XPP) latch the decision: winner stays at vdd,
* loser follows the tail node down; no output collapse, no crowbar.
XIN1 ma oa s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1
XIN2 mb ob s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1
XLC1 ma mb s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLC2 mb ma s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XPP1 ma mb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPP2 mb ma vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC1 ma clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPC2 mb clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XT1 s1 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=5 w=0.42 nf=1
XRS1 s1 clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* NAND set/reset hold latch.  Reset (clk low) has ma = mb = vdd,
* i.e. both inputs high = hold; evaluation pulls the loser low.
XNA mb tb t vss vdd nand2
XNB ma t tb vss vdd nand2
.ends cmpslice

* ---- top level ----------------------------------------------------
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
XCB clk clkb vss vdd invd
* reference ladder: eight 1 k segments, taps r1..r7 = 0.7 .. 1.3 V
RSEG1 vrefn r1 1k
RSEG2 r1 r2 1k
RSEG3 r2 r3 1k
RSEG4 r3 r4 1k
RSEG5 r4 r5 1k
RSEG6 r5 r6 1k
RSEG7 r6 r7 1k
RSEG8 r7 vrefp 1k
XS1 clk clkb vin r1 q1 vss vdd cmpslice
XS2 clk clkb vin r2 q2 vss vdd cmpslice
XS3 clk clkb vin r3 q3 vss vdd cmpslice
XS4 clk clkb vin r4 q4 vss vdd cmpslice
XS5 clk clkb vin r5 q5 vss vdd cmpslice
XS6 clk clkb vin r6 q6 vss vdd cmpslice
XS7 clk clkb vin r7 q7 vss vdd cmpslice
* thermometer-to-binary encoder
* b2 = t4
* b1 = (t2 & ~t4) | t6
* b0 = (t1 & ~t2) | (t3 & ~t4) | (t5 & ~t6) | t7
XI2 q2 q2b vss vdd inv
XI4 q4 q4b vss vdd inv
XI6 q6 q6b vss vdd inv
XI7 q7 q7b vss vdd inv
XNA q1 q2b na vss vdd nand2
XNB q3 q4b nb vss vdd nand2
XNC q5 q6b nc vss vdd nand2
XB0 na nb nc q7b b0 vss vdd nand4
XND q2 q4b nd vss vdd nand2
XB1 nd q6b b1 vss vdd nand2d
XB2 q4b b2 vss vdd invd
.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit sampled flash ADC.  All helper subcircuits are local and parameter-free.

.subckt adc_inv a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt adc_inv4 a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
.ends adc_inv4

.subckt adc_nand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 y a n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

.subckt adc_nand4 a b c d y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 y  a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN3 n2 c n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN4 n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends adc_nand4

* Complementary sampling switch, on while clk is low.
.subckt adc_sample a z clk clkb vdd vss
XN z clkb a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP z clk  a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends adc_sample

* Clocked regenerative comparator.  p is the sampled input and n the tap.
* Both decision nodes have identical buffer loading; t rises when p > n.
.subckt adc_cmp p n eval t td vdd vss
XPCHP dp eval vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPCHN dn eval vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPCP  dp dn   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPCN  dn dp   vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINP  dp p cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XINN  dn n cs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTAIL cs eval rt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
RTAIL rt vss 3k
XBP dp t  vdd vss adc_inv
XBN dn td vdd vss adc_inv
.ends adc_cmp

* Static transmission-gate latch, transparent while en is high.
.subckt adc_latch d en enb q vdd vss
XNI x en  d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPI x enb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XI1 x xb vdd vss adc_inv
XI2 xb q vdd vss adc_inv4
XNF x enb q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPF x en  q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends adc_latch

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Eight equal ideal sections place the seven decision levels at 0.7...1.3 V.
R0 vrefn r1 9.5k
R1 r1 r2 10k
R2 r2 r3 10k
R3 r3 r4 10k

circuit:
* 3-bit, rising-edge flash ADC.  All dimensions are in micrometres as
* required by the SKY130 continuous-model wrappers.

.subckt adc_inv vss vdd a y
XNI y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XPI y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

* CMOS transmission gate, on when c=1 and cb=0.
.subckt adc_tg vss vdd a y c cb
XGTN y c  a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XGTP y cb a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends adc_tg

* Rising-edge master/slave D flip-flop.  The master is transparent for
* clk=0, the slave for clk=1.
.subckt adc_dff vss vdd clk clkb d q
XDM1 vss vdd d   mn clkb clk adc_tg
XDM2 vss vdd mn  mnb adc_inv
XDM3 vss vdd mnb mfb adc_inv
XDM4 vss vdd mfb mn  clk clkb adc_tg
XDS1 vss vdd mnb sn  clk clkb adc_tg
XDS2 vss vdd sn  q   adc_inv
XDS3 vss vdd q   sfb adc_inv
XDS4 vss vdd sfb sn  clkb clk adc_tg
.ends adc_dff

* Symmetric continuous comparator.  Only the sign of vip-vim is used;
* the two output resistors therefore cancel process and supply shifts in
* the trip location.  A clocked DFF samples that sign at the rising edge.
.subckt adc_scmp vss vdd vip vim d
RSP sp vdd 50k
RSM sm vdd 50k
RST ss vss 20k
XSINP sp vip ss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
XSINM sm vim ss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=20 nf=2
* High-trip inverter converts the differential drain swing to full CMOS.
XSDP dn sp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=300 nf=10
XSDN dn sp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XSO1 vss vdd dn db adc_inv
XSO2 vss vdd db d  adc_inv
.ends adc_scmp

.subckt adc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XNN1 y  a nn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNN2 nn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNP1 y  a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XNP2 y  b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

* Static CMOS exclusive-OR made from four NAND gates.
.subckt adc_xor2 vss vdd a b y
XNX1 vss vdd a  b  nx adc_nand2
XNX2 vss vdd a  nx na adc_nand2
XNX3 vss vdd b  nx nb adc_nand2
XNX4 vss vdd na nb y  adc_nand2
.ends adc_xor2

* Clocked regenerative comparator followed by an active-low SR keeper.
* t is high after a rising clock edge when vip is greater than vim.
.subckt adc_cmp vss vdd clk vip vim t
* Dynamic decision nodes are precharged while clk is low.
XCP1 dn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
XCP2 dp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.4 nf=1
CDEC1 dn vss 20f
CDEC2 dp vss 20f
* Equalize the two dynamic nodes during the low (precharge) phase.
XCEQ dn clk dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
* Cross-coupled regeneration.
XCRP1 dn dp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
XCRP2 dp dn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
* The higher input discharges its corresponding decision node first.
XCIN1 dn vim ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
XCIN2 dp vip ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=1
XCTAIL ns clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8.0 nf=2
* Identical two-inverter buffers isolate the symmetric decision nodes from
* the state-dependent capacitance of the SR keeper.
XCDN1 vss vdd dn dni adc_inv
XCDN2 vss vdd dni dnr adc_inv
XCDP1 vss vdd dp dpi adc_inv
XCDP2 vss vdd dpi dpr adc_inv
* When dn falls, reset t.  When dp falls, set t.  During precharge both
* inputs are high and the cross-coupled NAND pair retains the decision.
XCS vss vdd dnr t  tb adc_nand2
XCR vss vdd dpr tb t  adc_nand2
.ends adc_cmp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Rising-edge one-shot.  eclk rises with clk and returns low after the RC
* delay, so comparator evaluation ends well before the external falling
* edge and the stored decisions are quiet throughout the valid window.
RCD clk cd 20k
CCD cd vss 130f
XCDI vss vdd cd cdn adc_inv
XCPN vss vdd clk cdn epb adc_nand2
XCPI vss vdd epb eclk adc_inv
* Eight equal segments place the seven thresholds at 0.7 V through 1.3 V
* for the specified 0.6 V to 1.4 V reference span.
RL0 vrefn r1 2.22k
RL1 r1 r2 2.74k
RL2 r2 r3 2.70k
RL3 r3 r4 2.36k
RL4 r4 r5 2.02k
RL5 r5 r6 1.40k
RL6 r6 vrefp 2.56k
R7L vrefn r7 14.26k
R7H r7 vrefp 1.74k
XTRK r7 r7 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=0.5 nf=1

XC1 vss vdd eclk vin r1 t1 adc_cmp
XC2 vss vdd eclk vin r2 t2 adc_cmp
XC3 vss vdd eclk vin r3 t3 adc_cmp
XC4 vss vdd eclk vin r4 t4 adc_cmp
XC5 vss vdd eclk vin r5 t5 adc_cmp
XC6 vss vdd eclk vin r6 t6 adc_cmp
XC7 vss vdd eclk vin r7 t7 adc_cmp

* For a bubble-free thermometer word, binary bits are thermometer parity:
* b2=t4, b1=t2^t4^t6, and b0=t1^t2^...^t7.
XB2I1 vss vdd t4 b2n adc_inv
XB2I2 vss vdd b2n b2 adc_inv

XB1X1 vss vdd t2 t4 b1x adc_xor2
XB1X2 vss vdd b1x t6 b1p adc_xor2
XB1I1 vss vdd b1p b1n adc_inv
XB1I2 vss vdd b1n b1 adc_inv

XB0X1 vss vdd t1 t2 b0x1 adc_xor2
XB0X2 vss vdd b0x1 t3 b0x2 adc_xor2
XB0X3 vss vdd b0x2 t4 b0x3 adc_xor2
XB0X4 vss vdd b0x3 t5 b0x4 adc_xor2
XB0X5 vss vdd b0x4 t6 b0x5 adc_xor2
XB0X6 vss vdd b0x5 t7 b0p adc_xor2
XB0I1 vss vdd b0p b0n adc_inv
XB0I2 vss vdd b0n b0 adc_inv
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C only.
* Architecture:
*   8-segment equal resistor ladder between vrefp(1.4) and vrefn(0.6)
*   7 clocked StrongARM sense comparators sampling vin directly on the
*   rising clk edge; taps stiffened with caps against kickback
*   NAND SR latches hold decisions through the low phase
*   static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder + output inverters (15 fF load)

* ---- basic static CMOS gates ----
.subckt ginv vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
.ends ginv

.subckt gnand2 vss vdd in1 in2 out
XN1 out in1 nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XN2 nx in2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
XP1 out in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
XP2 out in2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
.ends gnand2

.subckt gnand4 vss vdd in1 in2 in3 in4 out
XN1 out in1 n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XN2 n1 in2 n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XN3 n2 in3 n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XN4 n3 in4 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XP1 out in1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
XP2 out in2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
XP3 out in3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
XP4 out in4 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8
.ends gnand4

* ---- output driver sized for the 15 fF external load ----
.subckt gout vss vdd in out
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
.ends gout

* ---- clocked StrongARM sense comparator ----
* clk low: outp/outn precharged to vdd. On the rising edge the input
* pair develops the differential and the weak cross-coupled NMOS
* regenerate. The output nodes are deliberately much stiffer than the
* shared tail node x: the losing side's current pumps x up (cutting its
* input device off) after only a small droop of the surviving output.
* polarity: outp low when inp > inn (outn stays high).
.subckt sacomp vss vdd clk inp inn outp outn
XMP1 outp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XMP2 outn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XIP outp inp x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XIN outn inn x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XFP outp outn x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XFN outn outp x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT x clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5
COUTP outp vss 20f
COUTN outn vss 20f
* weak DC path so the operating point is defined when clk is low
RXD x vss 10meg
.ends sacomp

* ---- active-low NAND SR hold latch ----
* sn low -> q=1 ; rn low -> q=0 ; both high -> hold
.subckt srlatch vss vdd sn rn q qb
XS vss vdd sn qb q gnand2
XR vss vdd rn q qb gnand2
.ends srlatch

* ===================== DUT =====================
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* ladder: thresholds 0.65..1.25 (0.05 above vrefn, 0.15 below vrefp)
* unit R=1.5k -> 0.1V drop; bottom 0.75k (0.05), top 2.25k (0.15)
RL0 vrefn l1 0.75k
RL1 l1 l2 1.5k
RL2 l2 l3 1.5k
RL3 l3 l4 1.5k
RL4 l4 l5 1.5k
RL5 l5 l6 1.5k
RL6 l6 l7 1.5k
RL7 l7 vrefp 2.25k

* stiffening caps absorb comparator kickback
CL1 l1 vss 250f
CL2 l2 vss 250f
CL3 l3 vss 250f
CL4 l4 vss 250f
CL5 l5 vss 250f
CL6 l6 vss 250f
CL7 l7 vss 250f

* channel 1: threshold l1=0.65 (t1 set if vin >= 0.65)
XS1 vss vdd clk vin l1 sa1p sa1n sacomp
XL1 vss vdd sa1p sa1n t1 tb1 srlatch

* channel 2: threshold l2=0.75
XS2 vss vdd clk vin l2 sa2p sa2n sacomp
XL2 vss vdd sa2p sa2n t2 tb2 srlatch

* channel 3: threshold l3=0.85
XS3 vss vdd clk vin l3 sa3p sa3n sacomp
XL3 vss vdd sa3p sa3n t3 tb3 srlatch

* channel 4: threshold l4=0.95
XS4 vss vdd clk vin l4 sa4p sa4n sacomp
XL4 vss vdd sa4p sa4n t4 tb4 srlatch

* channel 5: threshold l5=1.05
XS5 vss vdd clk vin l5 sa5p sa5n sacomp
XL5 vss vdd sa5p sa5n t5 tb5 srlatch

* channel 6: threshold l6=1.15
XS6 vss vdd clk vin l6 sa6p sa6n sacomp
XL6 vss vdd sa6p sa6n t6 tb6 srlatch

* channel 7: threshold l7=1.25
XS7 vss vdd clk vin l7 sa7p sa7n sacomp
XL7 vss vdd sa7p sa7n t7 tb7 srlatch

* ---- thermometer-to-binary encoding ----
* b2 = t4
* b1 = t2.~t4 + t6
* b0 = t1.~t2 + t3.~t4 + t5.~t6 + t7
XN2 vss vdd t2 n2 ginv
XN4 vss vdd t4 n4 ginv
XN6 vss vdd t6 n6 ginv
XN7 vss vdd t7 n7 ginv

XNA vss vdd t2 n4 na gnand2
XB1 vss vdd na n6 b1pre gnand2

XP1B vss vdd t1 n2 p1 gnand2
XP2B vss vdd t3 n4 p2 gnand2
XP3B vss vdd t5 n6 p3 gnand2
XB0 vss vdd p1 p2 p3 n7 b0pre gnand4

* output chains (two inversions preserve polarity), final stage drives 15 fF
XOD21 vss vdd t4 b2pre ginv
XOD22 vss vdd b2pre b2 gout
XOD11 vss vdd b1pre b1a ginv
XOD12 vss vdd b1a b1 gout
XOD01 vss vdd b0pre b0a ginv
XOD02 vss vdd b0a b0 gout

.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C.
* Seven StrongARM clocked comparators, NAND SR hold latches, static CMOS
* thermometer-to-binary encoder, buffered rail outputs.

* ---- small static inverter ----
.subckt inv a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends inv

* ---- output driver inverter (15 fF load) ----
.subckt invbig a y vdd vss
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends invbig

* ---- 2-input NAND ----
.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 y a xn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 xn b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2

* ---- 4-input NAND ----
.subckt nand4 a b c d y vdd vss
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 y a x1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 x1 b x2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN3 x2 c x3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN4 x3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand4

* ---- double-tail comparator + NAND SR hold ----
* q = 1 when vina > vinb; qb is complement; state held while clk low
.subckt comp vss vdd clk vina vinb q qb
* stage 1: input integration (dp/dn precharged, differentially discharged)
XP1 dp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 dn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN1 dp vina s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XN2 dn vinb s1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XT1 s1 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* stage 2: regenerative latch driven by dp/dn
XP3 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP4 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC3 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPC4 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMS1 op dp s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XMS2 on dn s2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XT2 s2 clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* NAND SR hold
XSR1 on qb q vdd vss nand2
XSR2 op q qb vdd vss nand2
.ends comp

* =====================================================================
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* 8-segment resistor ladder, 1 k per segment (taps 0.7 ... 1.3 V)
RL0 vrefp t7 1k
RL1 t7 t6 1k
RL2 t6 t5 1k
RL3 t5 t4 1k
RL4 t4 t3 1k
RL5 t3 t2 1k
RL6 t2 t1 1k
RL7 t1 vrefn 1k
* per-tap decoupling to suppress comparator kickback errors
CT1 t1 vss 200f
CT2 t2 vss 200f
CT3 t3 vss 200f
CT4 t4 vss 200f
CT5 t5 vss 200f
CT6 t6 vss 200f
CT7 t7 vss 200f

* seven clocked comparators
XC1 vss vdd clk vin t1 q1 qb1 comp

* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V devices + ideal R/C.
* Resistor ladder (vrefp..vrefn), 7 clocked StrongARM-style comparators
* with NAND SR slave latches, static thermometer-to-binary encoder,
* clock input buffer and chained output inverters.

* ---- basic logic gates (fixed sizes, parameter free) ----
.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
.ends inv

.subckt inv_med vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
.ends inv_med

.subckt inv_out vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=4
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.72 nf=4
.ends inv_out

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* DC path for the series-stack middle node
RS1 n1 vss 10meg
.ends nand2

.subckt nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XN3 n2 c n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XN4 n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
* DC paths for the series-stack middle nodes
RS1 n1 vss 10meg
RS2 n2 vss 10meg
RS3 n3 vss 10meg
.ends nand4

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a n1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XP2 n1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* DC path for the series-stack middle node
RP1 n1 vdd 10meg
.ends nor2

.subckt xor2 vss vdd a b y
X0 vss vdd a b x0 nand2
X1 vss vdd a x0 x1 nand2
X2 vss vdd b x0 x2 nand2
X3 vss vdd x1 x2 y nand2
.ends xor2

* ---- clocked comparator: StrongARM sense amp + NAND SR latch ----
* q = 1 when vin > vr
.subckt cmp vss vdd clk vin vr q
* precharge input-pair drains x,y and outputs l,r (clk low -> vdd)
XPP1 x clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XPP2 y clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XPP3 l clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XPP4 r clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
* input pair and clocked tail
XN1 x vin tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XN2 y vr  tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XNT tail clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=2
* weak pull defines the floating tail node at DC (clk low)
RTL tail vss 10meg
* cross-coupled inverters: l=inv(r) stacked on x, r=inv(l) stacked on y
XPC1 l r vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2
XNC1 l r x   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=2
XPC2 r l vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.52 nf=2
XNC2 r l y   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.26 nf=2
* NAND SR slave latch: holds decision while clk is low
XNA vss vdd l qb q nand2
XNB vss vdd r q qb nand2
* weak pull-down gives the latch a unique DC state (q=0 during reset)
RQP q vss 1meg
.ends cmp

* ---- thermometer (t1..t7, t_i=1 when vin > 0.6+0.1*i) to binary ----
* Gray: g2 = t4, g1 = t2 ^ t6, g0 = 1 across code pairs (1,2) and (5,6)
.subckt enc vss vdd t1 t2 t3 t4 t5 t6 t7 b2 b1 b0
* inversions of the taps used by the g0 terms
XIT2 vss vdd t2 nt2 inv
XIT3 vss vdd t3 nt3 inv
XIT6 vss vdd t6 nt6 inv
XIT7 vss vdd t7 nt7 inv
* gray bit0: OR of (t1&!t2) | (t2&!t3) | (t5&!t6) | (t6&!t7)
XP1 vss vdd t1 nt2 p1 nand2
XP2 vss vdd t2 nt3 p2 nand2
XP3 vss vdd t5 nt6 p3 nand2
XP4 vss vdd t6 nt7 p4 nand2
XG0 vss vdd p1 p2 p3 p4 g0 nand4
* gray bit1 and binary bits
XG1 vss vdd t2 t6 g1 xor2
XB1 vss vdd g1 t4 b1r xor2
XB0 vss vdd b1r g0 b0r xor2
* output chains (b2 = t4)
XB2A vss vdd t4 b2a inv
XB2B vss vdd b2a b2 inv_med
XB1A vss vdd b1r b1a inv
XB1B vss vdd b1a b1 inv_med
XB0A vss vdd b0r b0a inv
XB0B vss vdd b0a b0 inv_med
.ends enc

* ---- top level ----
.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* clock input buffer (keeps 50 ohm clock-source load tiny)
XCK1 vss vdd clk ck1 inv
XCK2 vss vdd ck1 clkd inv_med
* reference ladder: 8 x 1 kOhm, taps tap1=0.7V .. tap7=1.3V
RL0 vrefp tap7 1k
RL1 tap7 tap6 1k
RL2 tap6 tap5 1k
RL3 tap5 tap4 1k
RL4 tap4 tap3 1k
RL5 tap3 tap2 1k
RL6 tap2 tap1 1k
RL7 tap1 vrefn 1k
* seven comparators
XC1 vss vdd clkd vin tap1 q1 cmp
XC2 vss vdd clkd vin tap2 q2 cmp
XC3 vss vdd clkd vin tap3 q3 cmp
XC4 vss vdd clkd vin tap4 q4 cmp
XC5 vss vdd clkd vin tap5 q5 cmp
XC6 vss vdd clkd vin tap6 q6 cmp
XC7 vss vdd clkd vin tap7 q7 cmp
* thermometer-to-binary encoder + output drivers
XENC vss vdd q1 q2 q3 q4 q5 q6 q7 b2 b1 b0 enc
.ends flash_adc_3bit

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V CMOS + ideal R/C.
* Architecture: 8-segment resistor ladder between vrefp/vrefn, seven
* clocked StrongARM comparators (LVT input pair) with buffered NOR SR
* hold latches, static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder, tapered output
* inverters driving the 15 fF loads.

* ---- static CMOS gates (fixed sizes) ----

.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt invdrv vss vdd a y
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=3
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
.ends invdrv

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XN2 n1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XP1 y a p1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XP2 p1 b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
XN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand4 vss vdd a b c d y
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP3 y c vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP4 y d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 y a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 n1 b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN3 n2 c n3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN4 n3 d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand4

* ---- clocked StrongARM comparator with NAND SR hold latch ----
* q = 1 when vin > vref, held through clock-low (precharge) phase.

.subckt sacomp vss vdd clk vin vref q
XPC1 op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPC2 on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPX1 op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XPX2 on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN1 op vin xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 on vref xs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNT xs clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
* Buffer raw drains so the StrongArm sees identical fixed loads (its
* decision threshold is independent of the prior latch state) and the
* SR hold latch is driven rail-to-rail.
XIB1 vss vdd op ip inv
XIB2 vss vdd on in inv
* active-high NOR SR: S=ip (op fell, vin>vref), R=in (on fell).
XNA vss vdd in qbar q nor2
XNB vss vdd ip q qbar nor2
.ends sacomp

* ---- top-level DUT ----

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* resistor ladder: 8 x 500 ohm, taps l1=1.3 .. l7=0.7 V
RL0 vrefp l1 500
RL1 l1 l2 500
RL2 l2 l3 500
RL3 l3 l4 500
RL4 l4 l5 500
RL5 l5 l6 500
RL6 l6 l7 500
RL7 l7 vrefn 500
* comparators: qk toggles at 0.6 + 0.1*k
XC1 vss vdd clk vin l7 q1 sacomp
XC2 vss vdd clk vin l6 q2 sacomp
XC3 vss vdd clk vin l5 q3 sacomp
XC4 vss vdd clk vin l4 q4 sacomp
XC5 vss vdd clk vin l3 q5 sacomp
XC6 vss vdd clk vin l2 q6 sacomp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin l1 q7 sacomp
* encoder:
*   b0 = q1!q2 + q3!q4 + q5!q6 + q7
*   b1 = q2!q4 + q6
*   b2 = q4
XNQ2 vss vdd q2 nq2 inv
XNQ4 vss vdd q4 nq4 inv
XNQ6 vss vdd q6 nq6 inv
XA1 vss vdd q1 nq2 a1 nand2
XA2 vss vdd q3 nq4 a2 nand2
XA3 vss vdd q5 nq6 a3 nand2
XA7 vss vdd q7 q7 a7 nand2
XZ0 vss vdd a1 a2 a3 a7 z0 nand4
XB1 vss vdd q2 nq4 bx1 nand2
XZ1 vss vdd bx1 nq6 z1 nand2
* tapered output buffers
XB0A vss vdd z0 w0 inv
XB0B vss vdd w0 b0 invdrv
XB1A vss vdd z1 w1 inv
XB1B vss vdd w1 b1 invdrv
XB2A vss vdd q4 w2 inv
XB2B vss vdd w2 b2 invdrv
.ends flash_adc_3bit

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Implement the complete flash ADC here: resistor-ladder references from
* vrefp/vrefn, seven clocked comparators sampling vin on the rising edge of
* clk, decision hold latches, and a transistor-logic thermometer-to-binary
* encoder driving the held outputs b2 b1 b0.

* Transistor-level 3-bit flash ADC using SKY130 1.8 V MOS and ideal R/C only.

.subckt adc_inv vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt adc_inv_cmp vss vdd a y
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1

.ends adc_inv_cmp

.subckt adc_nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMNA y a nmid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMNB nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends adc_nand2

.subckt adc_nor2 vss vdd a b y
XMPA y a pmid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMPB pmid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XMNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XMNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends adc_nor2

.subckt adc_and2 vss vdd a b y
XNAND vss vdd a b ny adc_nand2
XINV vss vdd ny y adc_inv
.ends adc_and2

.subckt adc_or2 vss vdd a b y
XNOR vss vdd a b ny adc_nor2
XINV vss vdd ny y adc_inv
.ends adc_or2

.subckt adc_tgate vss vdd a b en enb
XMN a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_tgate

.subckt adc_latch_hi vss vdd clk clkb d q
XDIN vss vdd d db adc_inv

XOUT vss vdd s q adc_inv
XFBINV vss vdd q fb adc_inv
XTFB vss vdd fb s clkb clk adc_tgate

.subckt adc_dyncomp vss vdd clk vin vref q
RTAIL tail vss 18k
XREF refd refd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=1
XLOAD out refd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=14 nf=1
XNREF refd vref tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XNVIN out vin tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
XQI0 vss vdd out qpre adc_inv_cmp
XQI1 vss vdd qpre qbufb adc_inv
XQI2 vss vdd qbufb q adc_inv
.ends adc_dyncomp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

RL4 r4 r5 10k
RL5 r5 r6 10k
RL6 r6 r7 10k
RL7 r7 vrefp 12.9k

CDLY cdly vss 30f
XDLYRST cdly clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XEARLYB vss vdd cdly earlyb adc_inv

XC6 vss vdd clk vin r6 c6 adc_dyncomp
XC7 vss vdd clk vin r7 c7 adc_dyncomp

XI1 vss vdd c1 nc1 adc_inv
XI2 vss vdd c2 nc2 adc_inv
XI3 vss vdd c3 nc3 adc_inv
XI4 vss vdd c4 nc4 adc_inv
XI5 vss vdd c5 nc5 adc_inv

XB1A vss vdd c2 nc4 b1_mid adc_and2

* 3-bit sampled flash ADC.  The comparison core is a matched, current-mirror
* differential pair; its only precision elements are the eight equal ladder
* resistors.  The input is tracked while clk is low and held for the high
* phase.  High-transparent output latches make the conversion visible only
* after the rising clock edge and retain it through the following track phase.

.subckt adc_inv a y vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
.ends adc_inv

* High-trip buffer used to digitize the partially discharged sense-latch node.
.subckt adc_inv_hi a y vdd vss

XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends adc_inv_hi

.subckt adc_inv_lo a y vdd vss

XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=7 nf=1

.subckt adc_nand2 a b y vdd vss

XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2

XMN2 nmid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2

.subckt adc_xor2 a b y vdd vss
XN1 a b n1 vdd vss adc_nand2
XN2 a n1 n2 vdd vss adc_nand2
XN3 b n1 n3 vdd vss adc_nand2
XN4 n2 n3 y vdd vss adc_nand2
.ends adc_xor2

* Two-stage dynamic comparator.  A resistor-loaded differential pair first
* develops a balanced voltage difference; a delayed strong-arm latch then
* regenerates it.  out is high for inp > inm.
.subckt adc_cmp inp inm out clk clkb vdd vss
RPP vdd pp 8k
RPN vdd pn 8k
XPD1 pp inp ps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XPD2 pn inm ps vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=4
XPT ps pree pb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
RPT pb vss 45k
CPP pp vss 5f
CPN pn vss 5f
RDEL clk dc 100k
CDEL dc vss 15f
XDI1 dc enb vdd vss adc_inv
XDI2 enb en1 vdd vss adc_inv
RDEL2 clk de 100k
CDEL2 de vss 50f
XDJ1 de e2b vdd vss adc_inv
XPG1 clk e2b preab vdd vss adc_nand2
XPG2 preab pree vdd vss adc_inv
XG1 en1 e2b ena vdd vss adc_nand2
XG2 ena en vdd vss adc_inv
XENI en enbh vdd vss adc_inv
XPREP op clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
XPREN on clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
XLIP op pn nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XLIN on pp nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XLTAIL nt en lb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=2
RLTAIL lb vss 30k
XLNP op on nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XLNN on op nt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XLPP op on vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=2
XLPN on op vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=2
* Equal two-inverter buffers keep the regenerative nodes balanced; out=on.
XI1 on ob1 vdd vss adc_inv_hi
XI2 ob1 dyn vdd vss adc_inv_lo
XI3 op db1 vdd vss adc_inv_hi
XI4 db1 dum vdd vss adc_inv_lo
XHOLD dyn out en enbh vdd vss adc_latch
.ends adc_cmp

* Positive-level-sensitive CMOS transmission-gate latch.  The feedback path
* closes as clk falls, retaining the just-resolved comparator word.
.subckt adc_latch d q clk clkb vdd vss
XINN n1 clk d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XINP n1 clkb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=2

XFBP n1 clk q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4 nf=2
XI1 n1 n2 vdd vss adc_inv
XOBP q n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=9.6 nf=4
XOBN q n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.8 nf=4
.ends adc_latch

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* published 0.6 V to 1.4 V reference endpoints.

RL1 r7 r6 1k

RL5 r3 r2 1k
RL6 r2 r1 1k

XC2 vss vdd t3 vin clk clk_pre p2 n2 bp2 cmp

.subckt adc_hold vss vdd clk d q
* A transmission-gate latch is transparent during the comparator evaluation
* phase and retains its decision after the falling clock edge.

XTGN x clk d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.8 nf=1
XTGP x clkb d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.6 nf=1

XI2 vss vdd y q adc_inv

.subckt adc_mirrorcomp vss vdd vb vin vr q

.subckt adc_dynsense vss vdd clk win gp gn q
* The input pair first develops a differential voltage on p/n.  A short
* delayed regeneration phase then turns on the cross-coupled latch.  This
* avoids a reset-race offset at the low end of the 0.6--1.4 V span.
XRP p clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XRN n clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XGP p gp ti vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XGN n gn ti vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTAIL ti win vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
RLEAK ti vss 1meg
RRG clk rd 100k
CRG rd vss 20f
XRG1 vss vdd rd rgb adc_inv
XRG2 vss vdd rgb regen adc_inv
XRGB vss vdd regen regenb adc_inv
XHDR lh regenb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=2
XLTAIL lt regen vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=1
XNLP p n lt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=1
XNLN n p lt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=1
XPLP p n lh vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=2
XPLN n p lh vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=2
XDUMMY vss vdd n dmy adc_inv
* Mirror q's sampling-latch gate capacitance at the complementary inverter.
XDMYH vss vdd win dmy dh adc_hold
XQINV vss vdd p q adc_inv
.ends adc_dynsense

.subckt adc_dyncomp vss vdd clk win vb vin vr q
* Two complementary mirror cells make the first decision differential.  A
* third matched cell resolves that differential before the rail-restoring
* inverters, substantially suppressing PVT movement of the CMOS threshold.
XPA vss vdd vb vin vr a adc_mirrorcomp
XPB vss vdd vb vr vin b adc_mirrorcomp
XPC vss vdd vb a b c adc_mirrorcomp
XI1 vss vdd c qi adc_inv
XI2 vss vdd qi q adc_inv
.ends adc_dyncomp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

R0 vrefp r7 9.4k
R1 r7 r6 10k
R2 r6 r5 10k
R3 r5 r4 10k
R4 r4 r3 10k
R5 r3 r2 10k
R6 r2 r1 10k

RBIASL vb vss 50k

RDEL clk cdel 250k
CDEL cdel vss 20f
XDELI vss vdd cdel cdelb adc_inv
XNWIN vss vdd clk cdelb nwin adc_nand2
XIWIN vss vdd nwin win0 adc_inv
XWINBUF vss vdd win0 win adc_buf

circuit:
* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC
* Ladder refs from vrefp/vrefn, 7 double-tail latched comparators,
* thermometer-to-binary encoder, full-rail output drivers.
* Legal devices: sky130 1.8V MOS, ideal R, ideal C.

.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt inv_x2 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends inv_x2

* Non-inverting output buffer (small inv + strong inv)
.subckt buf vss vdd a y
XI1 vss vdd a n inv
XI2 vss vdd n y inv_x2
.ends buf

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
* NOR: PMOS in series, NMOS in parallel
XPA y a m vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPB m b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNB y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nor2

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA y a m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNB m b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt and2 vss vdd a b y
XN vss vdd a b n nand2
XI vss vdd n y inv
.ends and2

.subckt or2 vss vdd a b y
XN vss vdd a b n nor2
XI vss vdd n y inv
.ends or2

* NOR SR hold latch: q = NOR(r, qb), qb = NOR(s, q)
* s/r both 0 holds the previous decision.
.subckt sr_latch vss vdd s r q qb
XN1 vss vdd r qb q nor2
XN2 vss vdd s q qb nor2
.ends sr_latch

* High-trip inverter for the preamp digitizers.  Stronger PMOS raises
* Vtrip toward the preamp output common-mode so the decision threshold
* sits at inp = inn rather than at the inverter trip.
.subckt inv_ht vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=1
.ends inv_ht

* Latched comparator: resistive-load preamp + high-trip digitizers +
* clk-gated valid-only SR hold.
* Loads are returned to vdd so the pair has a real supply path and the
* output common-mode sits near the digitizer trip.
* Track phase is clk-low: the tail is on and m1/m2 follow (inp-inn), so
* at the rising edge the digitizers already hold the conversion result.
* Capture phase is clk-high: AND-clk opens the SR, which latches that
* decision, then m1/m2 float back to vdd and the digitizers go to 00 so
* the SR keeps the last capture through the 9.5..19 ns window.
.subckt comp vss vdd clk vbias inp inn outp outn
* ---- preamp loads ----
RL1 vdd m1 100k
RL2 vdd m2 100k
* ---- input pair ----
XN1 m1 inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XN2 m2 inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* ---- tail current source + clk switch (on while clk is low) ----
XT tm vbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=1
XCLK vss vdd clk nclk inv
XEN tail nclk tm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=1
* ---- digitizers: d=1 when the preamp output is below Vtrip ----
XI1 vss vdd m1 d1 inv_ht
XI2 vss vdd m2 d2 inv_ht
* ---- valid-only capture: s = d1 & !d2 & clk, r = d2 & !d1 & clk ----
XL1 vss vdd d1 d1b inv
XL2 vss vdd d2 d2b inv
XA1 vss vdd d1 d2b s1 and2
XA2 vss vdd d2 d1b r1 and2
XA3 vss vdd s1 clk s and2
XA4 vss vdd r1 clk r and2
XSR vss vdd s r outp outn sr_latch
.ends comp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0

* ---- supply decoupling ----
CDD vdd vss 4p
CRR vrefp vss 2p

* ---- tail bias: diode NMOS + resistor ----
RBIAS vdd vbias 400k
XNB vbias vbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=2 nf=1

* ---- reference ladder: 8 x 1k, taps t1..t7 at 0.7 .. 1.3 V ----
RL1 vrefn t1 1k
RL2 t1 t2 1k
RL3 t2 t3 1k
RL4 t3 t4 1k
RL5 t4 t5 1k
RL6 t5 t6 1k
RL7 t6 t7 1k
RL8 t7 vrefp 1k
CF1 t1 vss 150f
CF2 t2 vss 150f
CF3 t3 vss 150f
CF4 t4 vss 150f
CF5 t5 vss 150f
CF6 t6 vss 150f
CF7 t7 vss 150f

* ---- seven comparators (outp is the held thermometer bit) ----
XC1 vss vdd clk vbias vin t1 s1 n1 comp
XC2 vss vdd clk vbias vin t2 s2 n2 comp
XC3 vss vdd clk vbias vin t3 s3 n3 comp
XC4 vss vdd clk vbias vin t4 s4 n4 comp
XC5 vss vdd clk vbias vin t5 s5 n5 comp
XC6 vss vdd clk vbias vin t6 s6 n6 comp
XC7 vss vdd clk vbias vin t7 s7 n7 comp

* ---- thermometer to binary (s1..s7 are the held digital bits) ----
* b2 = s4
* b1 = (s2 & !s4) | s6
* b0 = (s1 & !s2) | (s3 & !s4) | (s5 & !s6) | s7

* complements
XI2B vss vdd s2 n_s2 inv
XI4B vss vdd s4 n_s4 inv
XI6B vss vdd s6 n_s6 inv

* b1 path
XA1 vss vdd s2 n_s4 p1 and2
XO1 vss vdd p1 s6 b1i or2

* b0 path
XA2 vss vdd s1 n_s2 p2 and2
XA3 vss vdd s3 n_s4 p3 and2
XA4 vss vdd s5 n_s6 p4 and2
XO2 vss vdd p2 p3 q1 or2
XO3 vss vdd p4 s7 q2 or2
XO4 vss vdd q1 q2 b0i or2

* ---- output drivers (full rail into 15 fF) ----
XB2 vss vdd s4 b2 buf
XB1 vss vdd b1i b1 buf
XB0 vss vdd b0i b0 buf

.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC
* Ladder references, tracked-and-held inputs, StrongARM latches with
* decision hold, and a CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder.

* ---------- gates ----------
.subckt inv vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends inv

.subckt buf vss vdd a y
XU1 vss vdd a n inv
XU2 vss vdd n y inv
.ends buf

* sense buffer: first stage has a low trip point so a half-resolved
* comparator output reads as high and the hold latch keeps its state
.subckt buf_s vss vdd a y
XU1 vss vdd a n inv_l
XU2 vss vdd n y inv
.ends buf_s

.subckt inv_l vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
.ends inv_l

.subckt invw vss vdd a y
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
.ends invw

.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b y
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends nand2

.subckt nor2 vss vdd a b y
XMP1 y a mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMP2 mid b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XMN1 y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
XMN2 y b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=2
.ends nor2

.subckt and2 vss vdd a b y
XU1 vss vdd a b n nand2
XU2 vss vdd n y inv
.ends and2

.subckt or2 vss vdd a b y
XU1 vss vdd a b n nor2
XU2 vss vdd n y inv
.ends or2

* transmission gate a-b, closed while clk is low
.subckt tg vss vdd a b clk clk_b
XN a clk_b b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
XP a clk b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
.ends tg

* ---------- comparator ----------
* StrongARM latch. outp/outm precharge high while clk_d is low.
* Cross-coupled NMOS are isolated during reset so they do not fight the
* precharge pull-ups.
.subckt comp vss vdd clk_d vinn vinp outp outm
XPP outp clk_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XPM outm clk_d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XT tail clk_d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
XIP outp vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XIM outm vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XNP outp outm nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
XNX nx clk_d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
XNM outm outp ny vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
XNY ny clk_d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.1 nf=2
XCP outp outm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
XCM outm outp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.8 nf=2
* weak DC paths so tail/nx/ny are not floating at the operating point
RT tail vss 10meg
RNX nx vss 10meg
