* 3-bit flash ADC, 50 MS/s, vrefn..vrefp span.
* Architecture:
*  - 8-segment ideal resistor ladder (thresholds at vrefn + k*(vrefp-vrefn)/8)
*  - 7 clocked comparators: NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-mirror
*    load integrating the (vin - vt) difference onto y. The tail current is
*    pulsed on for ~1 ns after the rising clock edge so the decision forms,
*    then cut off so the stored state is charge-locked (no static power).
*  - master/slave hold flops clocked by a delayed copy of clk so the
*    decision is frozen a short time after the rising (conversion) edge,
*    well before the falling edge precharge can disturb the stored state
*  - static CMOS thermometer-to-binary encoder with full-swing buffers
* Only sky130 1.8 V MOS and ideal R/C are used.

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed-size logic helpers (parameter-free).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt finv1 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends finv1

.subckt finv2 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends finv2

.subckt finv3 vss vdd a y
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends finv3

.subckt fnand2 vss vdd a b y
XN1 y a m1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XN2 m1 b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.8 nf=1
XP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends fnand2

* y = a XOR b (four NANDs)
.subckt fxor2 vss vdd a b y
XW1 vss vdd a b w1 fnand2
XW2 vss vdd a w1 w2 fnand2
XW3 vss vdd b w1 w3 fnand2
XW4 vss vdd w2 w3 y fnand2
.ends fxor2

* Transmission gate, on when g=1 (gb=0); a and y symmetric.
.subckt ftgate vss vdd a y g gb
XN a g y vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP a gb y vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends ftgate

* Level-sensitive latch, transparent while ck is high; q = NOT(d).
.subckt fdlatch vss vdd ck ckb d q
XT1 vss vdd d n1 ck ckb ftgate
XI1 vss vdd n1 q finv1
XI2 vss vdd q n2 finv1
XT2 vss vdd n2 n1 ckb ck ftgate
.ends fdlatch

* Delay cell: inverter loaded with 25 fF, ~0.25 ns per stage.
.subckt fdly vss vdd a y
XI vss vdd a y finv1
CL y vss 25f
.ends fdly

* Comparator: y = 1 when vin > vt.
* NMOS differential pair (vin vs vt) with a PMOS current-mirror load.
* While clk is low, y is precharged to 0 and node a to vdd. Around the
* rising edge, pap goes high for ~1 ns and turns on the tail: the mirror
* copies the vin-side current into y while the vt-side device sinks from y,
* so y integrates upward at a rate proportional to (vin - vt). For vin < vt
* y is actively held low; for vin > vt it rises toward vdd. When pap falls,
* the tail opens and y is charge-locked (zero static power, no droop path).
.subckt fcmp vss vdd pap clkb clk vin vt y
XD y clkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XA a clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN1 a vin tt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XN2 y vt tt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNT tt pap vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2 nf=1
XP1 a a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
XP2 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=3 nf=1
CA a vss 8f
CY y vss 10f
.ends fcmp

* Top level.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked dynamic comparator.
*   lo goes low and hi goes high when vin > vrf, so hi = (vin > vrf).
*   During clk low both nodes are precharged to vdd.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Clocked differential amplifier comparator.
*   Resistive loads + current-source tail. lo = NOT(vin>vrf), hi = vin>vrf.
*   With the tail switch off both outputs return to vdd (reset).
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt adc_comp vss vdd clk vb vin vrf lo hi
RL1 vdd lo 100k
RL2 vdd hi 100k
XN1 lo vin s   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* StrongARM comparator.  inp=vin, inn=ref tap.
* s (=X1) goes low when inp>inn  ; r (=X2) goes low when inp<inn.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sa_cmp vss vdd clk inp inn s r
* tail
XM0 ta clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* input pair  (drains = regen nodes s,r)

XM2 r inn ta vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* precharge

XM4 r clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* cross-coupled regeneration PMOS (6T StrongARM core)

XM6 r s vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
.ends

*--------------------------------------------------------------------
* one held comparator bit: q=1 when vin>vref_tap (thermometer bit)
* StrongARM outputs s,r are squared by inverters (trip ~0.5vdd, below the
* common-mode dip floor) and captured in an active-high NOR SR latch, which
* holds during precharge and ignores the losing-node dip.
*------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt norsrlatch vss vdd sh rh q qb
XNO1 vss vdd sh qb q  nor2
XNO2 vss vdd rh q  qb nor2
.ends

.subckt cmp_bit vss vdd clk inp inn q qb
XC  vss vdd clk inp inn s r sa_cmp
XIS vss vdd s sh inv
XIR vss vdd r rh inv
XSL vss vdd sh rh q qb norsrlatch
.ends

XP2 o b x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
.ends nor2

* Clocked comparator with track-and-hold input and a decision latch.
* The held input is sampled on the rising edge of clk; d is high when the
* held input is at or below the tap voltage (d = 1 iff vin <= tap).
.subckt cmp vss vdd clk clkn vin tap d
* Sample switch: tracks vin while clk is low, holds at the rising edge.
XSW c clk vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
CH c vss 100f
* Precharge internal nodes while clk is low.
XPP p clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XPQ q clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Regenerative cross-coupled loads.
XMPA p q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMPB q p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Clocked differential pair on the held input versus the ladder tap.
XMN1 p c s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMN2 q tap s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XMNT s clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
* Decision latch: transparent while clk is high, holds while clk is low.
XTGN h clk q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XTGP h clkn q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=1
XI1 hb h vss vdd invwk
XI2 h hb vss vdd invwk
XI3 d h vss vdd inv
.ends cmp

* Thermometer (d_i = 1 iff vin <= tap i) to binary encoder.
* b2 = NOR4(d1..d4); b1 = ~d6 | (~d2 & d4);
* b0 = (~d1&d2) | (~d3&d4) | (~d5&d6) | (~d6&~d7)
.subckt enc vss vdd d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 b2 b1 b0
Xi1 i1 d1 vss vdd inv
Xi2 i2 d2 vss vdd inv
Xi3 i3 d3 vss vdd inv
Xi4 i4 d4 vss vdd inv
Xi5 i5 d5 vss vdd inv
Xi6 i6 d6 vss vdd inv
Xi7 i7 d7 vss vdd inv
* b2 = ~(d1|d2|d3|d4)
Xn12 n12 i1 i2 vss vdd nand2
Xn34 n34 i3 i4 vss vdd nand2
Xt2 t2 n12 n34 vss vdd nand2
* b1 = ~d6 | (~d2 & d4); compute ~b1 first
Xnt1 nt1 i2 d4 vss vdd nand2
XIt1 t1 nt1 vss vdd inv
Xnb1 nb1 i6 t1 vss vdd nor2
* b0 = (~d1&d2)|(~d3&d4)|(~d5&d6)|(~d6&~d7)
Xna12 na12 i1 d2 vss vdd nand2
Xa12 a12 na12 vss vdd inv
Xna34 na34 i3 d4 vss vdd nand2
Xa34 a34 na34 vss vdd inv
Xna56 na56 i5 d6 vss vdd nand2
Xa56 a56 na56 vss vdd inv
Xna67 na67 i6 i7 vss vdd nand2
Xa67 a67 na67 vss vdd inv
Xnb0 nb0 a12 a34 vss vdd nand2
Xnb0b nb0b a56 a67 vss vdd nand2
Xt0 t0 nb0 nb0b vss vdd nand2
* Non-inverting output buffers driving the 15 fF loads
Xo1 x2 t2 vss vdd inv
Xo2 b2 x2 vss vdd invw
Xo3 b1 nb1 vss vdd invw
Xo4 x0 t0 vss vdd inv
Xo5 b0 x0 vss vdd invw
.ends enc

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
XCK clk clkn vss vdd inv
* Resistor ladder: 8 x 2.5 k between vrefn (0.6 V) and vrefp (1.4 V),
* taps at 0.7 V ... 1.3 V in 0.1 V steps (40 uA ladder current).
RL1 vrefn t1 2500
RL2 t1 t2 2500
RL3 t2 t3 2500
RL4 t3 t4 2500
RL5 t4 t5 2500
RL6 t5 t6 2500
RL7 t6 t7 2500
RL8 t7 vrefp 2500
* Seven clocked comparators, one per threshold
XC1 vss vdd clk clkn vin t1 d1 cmp
XC2 vss vdd clk clkn vin t2 d2 cmp
XC3 vss vdd clk clkn vin t3 d3 cmp
XC4 vss vdd clk clkn vin t4 d4 cmp
XC5 vss vdd clk clkn vin t5 d5 cmp
XC6 vss vdd clk clkn vin t6 d6 cmp
XC7 vss vdd clk clkn vin t7 d7 cmp
* Thermometer-to-binary encoder with output buffers
XE vss vdd d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6 d7 b2 b1 b0 enc
.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit 50 MS/s flash ADC, Sky130 1.8 V 0.15 um CMOS
* Sample-and-hold -> seven latched comparators (ladder taps 0.7-1.3 V)
* -> output latches -> thermometer-to-binary encoder.
* Only Sky130 MOS, ideal resistors and ideal capacitors are used.

* Inverter
.subckt inv out in vss vdd
MP1 out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
MN1 out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.75 nf=1
.ends inv

* Non-inverting buffer
.subckt buf2 out in vss vdd
XI1 _x in vss vdd inv
XI2 out _x vss vdd inv
.ends buf2

* 2-input XNOR: out = a XNOR b (rail output, buffered non-inverting)
.subckt xnor2 out a b vss vdd
XI1 na a vss vdd inv
XI2 nb b vss vdd inv
MT1 out nb a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
MP1 out b a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
MT2 out b na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
MP2 out nb na vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XI3 _x out vss vdd inv
XI4 out _x vss vdd inv
.ends xnor2

* D latch: transparent while clk high, holds while clk low
.subckt latch d q vss vdd clk clkn
MT1 x d clk vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
MP1 x d clkn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XI1 q x vss vdd inv
XI2 Q q vss vdd inv
MT2 x Q clkn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
MP2 x Q clk vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
* q is the inverted storage node; Q follows d while clk high
.ends latch

* Strong-arm latched comparator: cn = high when sh > tap
* clk low: cp/cn/p precharged to vdd, inputs off
* clk high: regenerative decision, rails to vss/vdd
.subckt comp vss vdd clk sh tap cp cn
MPPCP cp clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
MPPCN cn clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
MPPU  p  clk vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
MNT   p  clk vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
MN1   cp sh p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
MN2   cn tap p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
MPX1  cp cn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
MPX2  cn cp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
RP    p  vss 1g
.ends comp

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
XI0 clkn clk vss vdd inv

* Sample-and-hold: TG switch tracks vin while clk low, holds at rising edge
MTHn sh clk vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=1
MTHp sh clkn vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
CH  sh vss 1p

* Resistor ladder: 8 x 25k between vrefp (1.4 V) and vrefn (0.6 V)
* taps t1..t7 = 1.3, 1.2, ..., 0.7 V
LR1 vrefp t1 25k
LR2 t1 t2 25k
LR3 t2 t3 25k
LR4 t3 t4 25k
LR5 t4 t5 25k
LR6 t5 t6 25k
LR7 t6 t7 25k
LR8 t7 vrefn 25k

* Seven comparators: cn_k high iff sh > 0.7 + 0.1*k (taps t7..t1)
XC0 vss vdd clk sh t7 cp0 cn0 comp
XC1 vss vdd clk sh t6 cp1 cn1 comp
XC2 vss vdd clk sh t5 cp2 cn2 comp
XC3 vss vdd clk sh t4 cp3 cn3 comp
XC4 vss vdd clk sh t3 cp4 cn4 comp
XC5 vss vdd clk sh t2 cp5 cn5 comp
XC6 vss vdd clk sh t1 cp6 cn6 comp

* Output latches hold decisions through the clk-low sample window
XL0 cn0 q0 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL1 cn1 q1 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL2 cn2 q2 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL3 cn3 b2 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL4 cn4 q4 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL5 cn5 q5 vss vdd clk clkn latch
XL6 cn6 q6 vss vdd clk clkn latch

* Encoder: b2 = q3 (wire)
* b1 = q1 XOR q4 XOR q5  (XNOR tree, even inversions -> parity)
XN45 x45 q4 q5 vss vdd xnor2
XN1  b1raw q1 x45 vss vdd xnor2
XB1  b1 b1raw vss vdd buf2

* b0 = parity of q0..q6 (six XNORs -> parity of seven inputs)
XN01 x01 q0 q1 vss vdd xnor2
XN23 x23 q2 q3 vss vdd xnor2
XN0123 x0123 x01 x23 vss vdd xnor2
XN456 x456 x45 q6 vss vdd xnor2
XN0  b0raw x0123 x456 vss vdd xnor2
XB0  b0 b0raw vss vdd buf2
.ends flash_adc_3bit

* 3-bit flash ADC, 0.6 V to 1.4 V reference span (0.1 V LSB).
* Sky130 1.8 V core MOS (PDK wrappers) and ideal resistors only.

* Weak inverting buffer (latch feedback).
.subckt inv_s vss vdd i o
Xni o i vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xpi o i vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
.ends inv_s

* Medium inverting buffer.
.subckt inv_m vss vdd i o
Xni o i vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xpi o i vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
.ends inv_m

* Strong inverting buffer for output drives.
.subckt inv_f vss vdd i o
Xni o i vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xpi o i vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
.ends inv_f

* Complementary pass gate: passes i to o when g = 1.
.subckt tg i o g gn vss vdd
Xn i o g vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xp i o gn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
.ends tg

* 2-input NAND gate.
.subckt nand2 vss vdd a b o
Xn1 x a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xn2 o b x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xp1 o a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
Xp2 o b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
.ends nand2

* 2-input XOR gate: y = a ^ b (a/an and b/bn true/complement pairs).
.subckt xor2 vss vdd a an b bn y
Xt1 a y bn b vss vdd tg
Xt2 an y b bn vss vdd tg
.ends xor2

* Static comparator: d = 1 when vin > vref. Current-source tail biased
* from the 0.7 V ladder tap keeps the tail node low and stable over
* common-mode, so the inverter output rails are clean logic levels.
.subckt comp vss vdd vin vref vbias d
Xn1 x s vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xn2 y s vref vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xp1 x x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
Xp2 y x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8
Xb s vbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8
Xi vss vdd x d inv_m
.ends comp

* Rising-edge D flip-flop: q <= d at the rising edge of clk.
.subckt dff vss vdd clk clkn d q
Xtm d x clkn clk vss vdd tg
Xia x xb vss vdd inv_s
Xib xb x vss vdd inv_s
Xts x y clk clkn vss vdd tg
Xic y yb vss vdd inv_s
Xid yb y vss vdd inv_s
Xi1 y yi vss vdd inv_m
Xi2 yi q vss vdd inv_f
.ends dff

.subckt flash_adc_3bit vss vdd vrefn vrefp clk vin b2 b1 b0
* Resistor ladder: taps lt1..lt7 = 1.3 V .. 0.7 V (0.1 V LSB).
Rl1 vrefp lt1 100k
Rl2 lt1 lt2 100k
Rl3 lt2 lt3 100k
Rl4 lt3 lt4 100k
Rl5 lt4 lt5 100k
Rl6 lt5 lt6 100k
Rl7 lt6 lt7 100k
Rl8 lt7 vrefn 100k
* Clock inverter.
Xci vss vdd clk clkn inv_m
* Comparator bank: dk = 1 when vin > 0.6 V + 0.1 V*k; bias from lt7 (0.7 V).
Xc1 vss vdd vin lt7 lt7 d1 comp
Xc2 vss vdd vin lt6 lt7 d2 comp
Xc3 vss vdd vin lt5 lt7 d3 comp
Xc4 vss vdd vin lt4 lt7 d4 comp
Xc5 vss vdd vin lt3 lt7 d5 comp
Xc6 vss vdd vin lt2 lt7 d6 comp
Xc7 vss vdd vin lt1 lt7 d7 comp
* Decision registers, clocked on the rising edge.
Xd1 vss vdd clk clkn d1 q1 dff
Xd2 vss vdd clk clkn d2 q2 dff
Xd3 vss vdd clk clkn d3 q3 dff
Xd4 vss vdd clk clkn d4 q4 dff
Xd5 vss vdd clk clkn d5 q5 dff
Xd6 vss vdd clk clkn d6 q6 dff
Xd7 vss vdd clk clkn d7 q7 dff
* Complements of the thermometer bits.
Xi1 vss vdd q1 nq1 inv_m
Xi2 vss vdd q2 nq2 inv_m
Xi3 vss vdd q3 nq3 inv_m
Xi4 vss vdd q4 nq4 inv_m
Xi5 vss vdd q5 nq5 inv_m
Xi6 vss vdd q6 nq6 inv_m
Xi7 vss vdd q7 nq7 inv_m
* Encoder: b2 = q4; b1 = (q2 & ~q4) | q6; b0 = parity(q1..q7).
Xib2 vss vdd nq4 b2 inv_f
Xn1 vss vdd q2 nq4 na1 nand2
Xn2 vss vdd na1 nq6 nb1 nand2
Xinb vss vdd nb1 nnb1 inv_m
Xib1 vss vdd nnb1 b1 inv_f
Xx1 vss vdd q1 nq1 q2 nq2 y1 xor2
Xiy1 vss vdd y1 ny1 inv_m
Xx2 vss vdd y1 ny1 q3 nq3 y2 xor2
Xiy2 vss vdd y2 ny2 inv_m
Xx3 vss vdd y2 ny2 q4 nq4 y3 xor2
Xiy3 vss vdd y3 ny3 inv_m
Xx4 vss vdd y3 ny3 q5 nq5 y4 xor2
Xiy4 vss vdd y4 ny4 inv_m
Xx5 vss vdd y4 ny4 q6 nq6 y5 xor2
Xiy5 vss vdd y5 ny5 inv_m
Xx6 vss vdd y5 ny5 q7 nq7 y6 xor2
Xiy6 vss vdd y6 ny6 inv_m
Xib0 vss vdd ny6 b0 inv_f
.ends flash_adc_3bit
